title.zh: 卷7 志第2 禮儀二
title.raw: 卷7 志第2 禮儀二 Volume 7 Treatises 2: Rites 2

sentences.zh: 禮儀二

translations.literal: Rites 2
translations.idiomatic: Rites 2

sentences.zh: 《春秋》「龍見而雩」，梁制不為恆祀。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals says, 'When the dragon appears, perform the rain sacrifice'—under Liang practice this was not made a regular sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals records that 'when the dragon star appears, the rain sacrifice is performed,' but under Liang practice this was not established as a regular seasonal rite.

sentences.zh: 四月後旱，則祈雨，行七事：一，理冤獄及失職者；

translations.literal: After the fourth month, if drought occurred, rain was prayed for and seven measures were carried out: first, redress wrongful imprisonments and restore those dismissed from office;
translations.idiomatic: If drought persisted after the fourth month, the court prayed for rain and undertook seven measures: first, review wrongful cases and reinstate officials who had been dismissed without cause;

sentences.zh: 二，振鰥寡孤獨者；

translations.literal: second, relieve widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary;
translations.idiomatic: second, provide relief to widowers, widows, orphans, and those living alone;

sentences.zh: 三，省繇輕賦；

translations.literal: third, reduce corvée and lighten taxes;
translations.idiomatic: third, reduce corvée labor and lighten tax burdens;

sentences.zh: 四，舉進賢良；

translations.literal: fourth, recommend worthy and good men;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, recommend men of talent and integrity;

sentences.zh: 五，黜退貪邪；

translations.literal: fifth, dismiss the greedy and corrupt;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, remove greedy and corrupt officials from office;

sentences.zh: 六，命會男女，恤怨曠；

translations.literal: sixth, order the pairing of men and women and show concern for those separated and unmarried;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, order officials to arrange marriages for the unmarried and show concern for those separated from spouses or left without partners;

sentences.zh: 七，撤膳羞，弛樂懸而不作。

translations.literal: seventh, withdraw delicacies from the table and suspend the hanging bells so that music was not performed.
translations.idiomatic: seventh, withdraw delicacies from the imperial table and suspend the hanging bells so that no music was played.

sentences.zh: 天子又降法服。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven also donned plain ritual robes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also put aside his formal robes and wore plain ritual dress.

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈社稷；

translations.literal: After seven days, the altars of soil and grain were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: After seven days, prayers were offered at the altars of soil and grain;

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈山林川澤常興雲雨者；

translations.literal: after seven days, mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes that regularly brought clouds and rain were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, prayers were offered to mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes known to raise clouds and bring rain;

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈群廟之主於太廟；

translations.literal: after seven days, the lords of the collective temples were prayed to in the Grand Temple;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, the spirit tablets of the collective ancestral temples were invoked in prayer at the Grand Temple;

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈古來百辟卿士有益於人者；

translations.literal: after seven days, ministers and officers of antiquity who had benefited the people were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, prayers were offered to ministers and officers of antiquity who had benefited the people;

sentences.zh: 七日，乃大雩，祈上帝，遍祈所有事者。

translations.literal: after seven days, the great rain sacrifice was performed, praying to the Supreme Lord and offering prayers comprehensively to all relevant spirits.
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, the great rain sacrifice was performed, with prayers to the Supreme Lord and comprehensive supplication to every spirit concerned.

sentences.zh: 大雩禮，立圓壇于南郊之左，高及輪廣四丈，周十二丈，四陛。

translations.literal: For the great rain sacrifice, a round altar was erected to the left of the southern suburb, as high as a wheel and four zhang wide, twelve zhang in circumference, with four stairways.
translations.idiomatic: In the great rain sacrifice, a round altar was built to the left of the southern suburban precinct, one wheel's height and four zhang across, twelve zhang in circumference, with four stairways.

sentences.zh: 牲用黃牯牛一。

translations.literal: The offering animal was one yellow bull.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial victim was one yellow bull.

sentences.zh: 祈五天帝及五人帝於其上，各依其方，以太祖配，位於青帝之南，五官配食於下。

translations.literal: The Five Heavenly Emperors and the Five Human Emperors were prayed to upon it, each according to his direction; the Founding Ancestor was associated in the offering, placed south of the Green Emperor, and the Five Officials were associated below as secondary recipients.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the altar the Five Heavenly Emperors and the Five Human Emperors were invoked, each positioned according to his direction; the Founding Ancestor was associated in the offering, placed south of the Green Emperor, while the Five Officials received secondary offerings below.

sentences.zh: 七日乃去樂。

translations.literal: After seven days the music was removed.
translations.idiomatic: After seven days the music was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 又遍祈社稷山林川澤，就故地處大雩。

translations.literal: Prayers were also offered comprehensively at the altars of soil and grain, mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes, and the great rain sacrifice was performed at the original sites.
translations.idiomatic: Prayers were also offered comprehensively at the altars of soil and grain and at mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes, with the great rain sacrifice performed at each established site.

sentences.zh: 國南除地為墠，舞童六十四人。

translations.literal: South of the capital, ground was cleared for a ritual platform, with sixty-four dancing youths.
translations.idiomatic: South of the capital, ground was cleared for a ritual dance platform, and sixty-four youths were assigned to dance.

sentences.zh: 祈百辟卿士於雩壇之左，除地為墠，舞童六十四人，皆袨服，為八列，各執羽翳。

translations.literal: Ministers and officers of antiquity were prayed to to the left of the rain altar; ground was cleared for a platform, sixty-four dancing youths, all in ceremonial dress, formed eight ranks, each holding feather fans.
translations.idiomatic: To the left of the rain altar, ministers and officers of antiquity were invoked; ground was cleared for a platform where sixty-four youths in ceremonial dress formed eight ranks, each holding feather fans.

sentences.zh: 每列歌《雲漢》詩一章而畢。

translations.literal: Each rank sang one chapter of the 'Clouds Ascending' ode and then finished.
translations.idiomatic: Each rank sang one stanza from the 'Clouds Ascending' ode and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 旱而祈澍，則報乙太牢，皆有司行事。

translations.literal: When drought was prayed against and timely rain came, a response sacrifice of the secondary great offering was performed, all carried out by the relevant officials.
translations.idiomatic: When prayers during drought were answered with timely rain, a response sacrifice of the secondary great offering was performed, with the appropriate officials conducting the rite.

sentences.zh: 唯雩則不報。

translations.literal: Only for the rain sacrifice itself was no response sacrifice made.
translations.idiomatic: Only the rain sacrifice itself was not followed by a response offering.

sentences.zh: 若郡國縣旱請雨，則五事同時並行：一，理冤獄失職；

translations.literal: If commanderies, kingdoms, or counties suffered drought and requested rain, five measures were carried out simultaneously: first, redress wrongful imprisonments and restore the dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: When commanderies, kingdoms, or counties suffered drought and petitioned for rain, five measures were undertaken at once: first, review wrongful cases and reinstate dismissed officials;

sentences.zh: 二，存鰥寡孤獨；

translations.literal: second, provide for widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary;
translations.idiomatic: second, provide for widowers, widows, orphans, and those living alone;

sentences.zh: 三，省徭役；

translations.literal: third, reduce corvée;
translations.idiomatic: third, reduce corvée labor;

sentences.zh: 四，進賢良；

translations.literal: fourth, recommend worthy and good men;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, recommend men of talent and integrity;

sentences.zh: 五，退貪邪。

translations.literal: fifth, dismiss the greedy and corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, remove greedy and corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 守令皆潔齋三日，乃祈社稷。

translations.literal: The prefects and magistrates all purified themselves and fasted for three days, then prayed at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: All prefects and magistrates purified themselves and fasted for three days before offering prayers at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 七日不雨，更齋祈如初。

translations.literal: If after seven days there was no rain, they fasted again and prayed as at first.
translations.idiomatic: If no rain fell within seven days, they renewed their fast and prayed again as before.

sentences.zh: 三變仍不雨，複齋祈其界內山林川澤常興雲雨者。

translations.literal: If after three repetitions there was still no rain, they again fasted and prayed to mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within their jurisdiction that regularly brought clouds and rain.
translations.idiomatic: If after three repetitions rain still did not come, they fasted once more and prayed to mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within their jurisdiction that were known to raise clouds and rain.

sentences.zh: 祈而澍，亦各有報。

translations.literal: When prayers were answered with timely rain, each also had its response sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When prayers were answered with timely rain, each site also received its own response sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 陳氏亦因梁制，祈而澍則報以少牢。

translations.literal: The Chen dynasty also followed Liang practice; when prayers were answered with timely rain, the response was made with the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen dynasty likewise followed Liang practice: when prayers were answered with timely rain, the response sacrifice was performed with the secondary offering.

sentences.zh: 武帝時，以德皇帝配，文帝時，以武帝配。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wu, the Virtuous Emperor was associated; under Emperor Wen, Emperor Wu was associated.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu, the Virtuous Emperor served as associated offering; under Emperor Wen, Emperor Wu served as associated offering.

sentences.zh: 廢帝即位，以文帝配青帝。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor ascended the throne, Emperor Wen was associated with the Green Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne, Emperor Wen was associated with the Green Emperor in the offering.

sentences.zh: 牲用黃牯牛，而以清酒四升洗其首。

translations.literal: The offering animal was a yellow bull, and four sheng of clear wine were used to wash its head.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial victim was a yellow bull, its head washed with four sheng of clear wine.

sentences.zh: 其壇墠配饗歌舞，皆如梁禮。

translations.literal: The altar platform, associated offerings, and dances all followed Liang ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The altar platform, associated offerings, and dance performances all followed Liang ritual practice.

sentences.zh: 天子不親奉，則太宰、太常、光祿行三獻禮。

translations.literal: If the Son of Heaven did not personally perform the offering, the Grand Steward, Grand Master of Ceremonies, and Director of Imperial Entertainments performed the triple-presentation rite.
translations.idiomatic: If the emperor did not personally perform the offering, the Grand Steward, Grand Master of Ceremonies, and Director of Imperial Entertainments conducted the triple-presentation rite.

sentences.zh: 其法皆采齊建武二年事也。

translations.literal: These regulations all drew on events of the second year of Jianwu in Qi.
translations.idiomatic: These regulations all drew upon precedents from the second year of the Jianwu era in Qi.

sentences.zh: 梁、陳制，諸祠官皆給除穢氣藥，先齋一日報之，以取清潔。

translations.literal: Under Liang and Chen practice, all sacrificial officials were given medicine to dispel impurity; one day before fasting they reported this, to attain purity.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang and Chen practice, all sacrificial officials were given medicine to dispel impurity; one day before fasting they reported having taken it, to ensure ritual purity.

sentences.zh: 天監九年，有事雩壇。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianjian, the rain altar was used for a sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianjian, a sacrifice was performed at the rain altar.

sentences.zh: 武帝以為雨既類陰，而求之正陽，其謬已甚。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu held that since rain belongs to the yin category, to seek it in the place of utmost yang was a grave error.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu reasoned that since rain belongs to the yin category, to seek it in the place of utmost yang was a profound error.

sentences.zh: 東方既非盛陽，而為生養之始，則雩壇應在東方，祈晴亦宜此地。

translations.literal: The east, though not the height of yang, is the beginning of generation and nurture; therefore the rain altar should be in the east, and prayers for clear weather should also be made there.
translations.idiomatic: The east, though not the peak of yang, is where generation and nurture begin; therefore the rain altar should stand in the east, and prayers for clear weather should likewise be offered there.

sentences.zh: 於是遂移於東郊。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was moved to the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The altar was accordingly moved to the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 十年，帝又以雩祭燔柴，以火祈水，於理為乖。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the emperor also held that burning firewood in the rain sacrifice—using fire to pray for water—was contrary to principle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the emperor also held that burning firewood in the rain sacrifice—using fire to pray for water—was contrary to ritual principle.

sentences.zh: 儀曹郎硃異議曰：「案周宣《雲漢》之詩，毛注有瘞埋之文，不見有燔柴之說。

translations.literal: Zhu Yi, Gentleman of the Ceremonial Bureau, submitted an opinion: 'According to Duke Xuan's ode "Clouds Ascending," Mao's commentary mentions burial offerings, but nowhere mentions burning firewood.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi of the Ceremonial Bureau submitted an opinion: 'According to the "Clouds Ascending" ode in Duke Xuan's Book of Songs, Mao's commentary mentions burial offerings, but nowhere mentions burning firewood.'

sentences.zh: 若以五帝必柴，今明堂又無其事。

translations.literal: If the Five Emperors must be honored with fire, yet at the Bright Hall today there is no such practice.
translations.idiomatic: If the Five Emperors must always receive fire offerings, yet at the Bright Hall today no such practice exists.

sentences.zh: 於是停用柴，從坎瘞典。

translations.literal: Thereupon the use of firewood was discontinued, and the pit-burial precedent was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The use of firewood was therefore discontinued, and the pit-burial precedent was adopted instead.

sentences.zh: 十一年，帝曰：「四望之祀，頃來遂絕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the emperor said: 'The sacrifice to the Four Quarters has lately been entirely discontinued.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the emperor said: 'The sacrifice to the Four Quarters has lately fallen entirely into disuse.'

sentences.zh: 宜更議複。

translations.literal: It should be reconsidered and restored.
translations.idiomatic: It should be reconsidered and restored.

sentences.zh: 」硃異議：「鄭眾雲：'四望謂日月星海。

translations.literal: Zhu Yi submitted an opinion: 'Zheng Zhong says: "The Four Quarters mean the sun, moon, stars, and sea."'
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi submitted an opinion: 'Zheng Zhong says: "The Four Quarters refer to the sun, moon, stars, and sea."'

sentences.zh: '鄭玄雲：'謂五嶽四鎮四瀆。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan says: 'They mean the Five Sacred Peaks, the Four Guardian Mountains, and the Four Rivers.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan says: 'They refer to the Five Sacred Peaks, the Four Guardian Mountains, and the Four Rivers.'

sentences.zh: '尋二鄭之說，互有不同。

translations.literal: Examining the two Zheng scholars' explanations, they differ from each other.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the two Zheng scholars' explanations, they clearly differ from each other.

sentences.zh: 竊以望是不即之名，凡厥遙祭，皆有斯目。

translations.literal: I hold that 'quarter' is a general term for what is not immediately present; all distant sacrifices bear this designation.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that 'quarter' is a general term for what is not immediately present; all distant sacrifices fall under this designation.

sentences.zh: 豈容局於星漢，拘於海瀆？

translations.literal: How can one be confined to the stars and Milky Way, or restricted to seas and rivers?
translations.idiomatic: How can the term be confined to the stars and Milky Way, or restricted to seas and rivers alone?

sentences.zh: 請命司天，有關水旱之義，爰有四海名山大川，能興雲致雨，一皆備祭。

translations.literal: I request that the Directorate of Astronomy be ordered, wherever the meaning of water and drought is concerned, and wherever within the Four Seas there are famous mountains and great rivers that can raise clouds and bring rain—all should be included in the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Directorate of Astronomy be consulted: wherever the rites concern water and drought, and wherever within the Four Seas there are famous mountains and great rivers capable of raising clouds and bringing rain—all should be included in the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 又揚州主簿顧協又雲：「《禮》'仲夏大雩'，《春秋》'龍見而雩'，則雩常祭也，水旱且又禱之，謂宜式備斯典。

translations.literal: Gu Xie, Registrar of Yang Province, also said: 'The Rites say "great rain sacrifice in midsummer," and the Spring and Autumn Annals say "when the dragon appears, perform the rain sacrifice"—thus the rain sacrifice is a regular rite, and in drought it is additionally prayed; I hold that this canonical precedent should be fully observed.'
translations.idiomatic: Gu Xie, Registrar of Yang Province, also argued: 'The Rites prescribe a great rain sacrifice in midsummer, and the Spring and Autumn Annals record that when the dragon appears the rain sacrifice is performed—thus the rain sacrifice is a regular seasonal rite, with additional prayers in drought; this canonical precedent should be fully observed.'

sentences.zh: 」太常博士亦從協議。

translations.literal: The Erudite of the Grand Master of Ceremonies also followed Gu's opinion.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite of the Grand Master of Ceremonies also supported Gu's opinion.

sentences.zh: 祠部郎明岩卿以為：「祈報之祀，已備郊禋，沿革有時，不必同揆。

translations.literal: Ming Yanqing, Gentleman of the Sacrificial Bureau, held: 'Prayer and response sacrifices are already provided for in the suburban and suburban-fire rites; practices evolve with the times and need not be uniformly applied.'
translations.idiomatic: Ming Yanqing of the Sacrificial Bureau held: 'Prayer and response sacrifices are already provided for in the suburban and fire rites; ritual practice evolves with the times and need not be uniformly applied.'

sentences.zh: 」帝從其議，依舊不改。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this opinion and left the old practice unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted this opinion and left the existing practice unchanged.

sentences.zh: 大同五年，又築雩壇于藉田兆內。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Datong, a rain altar was again built within the sacred field precinct.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Datong, a rain altar was again constructed within the sacred field precinct.

sentences.zh: 有祈 珝，則齋官寄藉田省雲。

translations.literal: When there were rain prayers, the fasting official stayed at the sacred field precinct to observe the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: When rain prayers were performed, the fasting official lodged at the sacred field precinct to observe the clouds.

sentences.zh: 後齊以孟夏龍見而雩，祭太微五精帝于夏郊之東。

translations.literal: Later Qi, in the first month of summer when the dragon appeared, performed the rain sacrifice, sacrificing to the Five Essence Emperors of the Great Microcosm in the east of the summer suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi, when the dragon star appeared in the first month of summer, performed the rain sacrifice, offering to the Five Essence Emperors of the Great Microcosm in the eastern summer suburban precinct.

sentences.zh: 為圓壇，廣四十五尺，高九尺，四面各一陛。

translations.literal: A round altar was made, forty-five chi wide and nine chi high, with one stairway on each of the four sides.
translations.idiomatic: A round altar was constructed, forty-five chi in width and nine chi in height, with one stairway on each of the four sides.

sentences.zh: 為三壝外營，相去深淺，並燎壇，一如南郊。

translations.literal: Three outer enclosures were made as outer camps, spaced at varying depths, together with fire altars, all as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Three outer enclosures formed the outer precinct, spaced at varying depths, with fire altars as at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 于其上祈穀實，以顯宗文宣帝配。

translations.literal: Upon it grain and fruit were prayed for, with Emperor Wenxuan of the Manifest Ancestor associated.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the altar prayers were offered for grain and fruit, with Emperor Wenxuan of the Manifest Ancestor as associated offering.

sentences.zh: 青帝在甲寅之地，赤帝在丙巳之地，黃帝在己未之地，白帝在庚申之地，黑帝在壬亥之地。

translations.literal: The Green Emperor was in the jia-yin position, the Red Emperor in the bing-si position, the Yellow Emperor in the ji-wei position, the White Emperor in the geng-shen position, and the Black Emperor in the ren-hai position.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Emperor stood in the jia-yin position, the Red Emperor in the bing-si position, the Yellow Emperor in the ji-wei position, the White Emperor in the geng-shen position, and the Black Emperor in the ren-hai position.

sentences.zh: 面皆內向，藉以槁秸。

translations.literal: All faced inward, spread with straw.
translations.idiomatic: All faced inward, their platforms spread with straw.

sentences.zh: 配帝在青帝之南，小退，藉以莞席，牲以騂。

translations.literal: The associated emperor was south of the Green Emperor, slightly withdrawn, spread with rush mats; the victim was a red bull.
translations.idiomatic: The associated emperor was placed south of the Green Emperor, slightly withdrawn, upon rush mats; the sacrificial victim was a red bull.

sentences.zh: 其儀同南郊。

translations.literal: The ceremony was the same as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed the same order as at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 又祈禱者有九焉：一曰雩，二曰南郊，三曰堯廟，四曰孔、顏廟，五曰社稷，六曰五嶽，七曰四瀆，八曰滏口，九曰豹祠。

translations.literal: There were also nine types of prayer: first, rain sacrifice; second, southern suburb; third, the Temple of Yao; fourth, the temples of Confucius and Yan; fifth, the altars of soil and grain; sixth, the Five Sacred Peaks; seventh, the Four Rivers; eighth, Fokou; ninth, the Leopard Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: There were also nine forms of prayer: first, the rain sacrifice; second, the southern suburb; third, the Temple of Yao; fourth, the temples of Confucius and Yan; fifth, the altars of soil and grain; sixth, the Five Sacred Peaks; seventh, the Four Rivers; eighth, Fokou; ninth, the Leopard Shrine.

sentences.zh: 水旱癘疫，皆有事焉。

translations.literal: For flood, drought, and pestilence, rites were performed at all of these.
translations.idiomatic: For floods, droughts, and pestilence, rites were performed at each of these sites.

sentences.zh: 無牲，皆以酒脯棗栗之饌。

translations.literal: No victims were used; all employed offerings of wine, dried meat, dates, and chestnuts.
translations.idiomatic: No sacrificial victims were used; all offerings consisted of wine, dried meat, dates, and chestnuts.

sentences.zh: 若建午、建未、建申之月不雨，則使三公祈五帝於雩壇。

translations.literal: If in the months of wu, wei, or shen of the year there was no rain, the Three Excellencies were sent to pray to the Five Emperors at the rain altar.
translations.idiomatic: If the months of wu, wei, or shen passed without rain, the Three Excellencies were dispatched to pray to the Five Emperors at the rain altar.

sentences.zh: 禮用玉幣，有燎，不設金石之樂，選伎工端潔善謳詠者，使歌《雲漢》詩于壇南。

translations.literal: The rite used jade and silks; there was fire offering; stone and metal music was not set up; skilled and pure singers were selected to sing the 'Clouds Ascending' ode south of the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The rite employed jade and silks with fire offerings; stone and metal instruments were not used; skilled, pure singers were selected to sing the 'Clouds Ascending' ode south of the altar.

sentences.zh: 自餘同正雩。

translations.literal: The remainder was the same as the regular rain sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: All other details followed the regular rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 南郊則使三公祈五天帝於郊壇，有燎，座位如雩。

translations.literal: At the southern suburb the Three Excellencies were sent to pray to the Five Heavenly Emperors at the suburban altar; there was fire offering; seating was as at the rain sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern suburb the Three Excellencies were dispatched to pray to the Five Heavenly Emperors at the suburban altar, with fire offerings and seating arranged as at the rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 五人帝各在天帝之左。

translations.literal: Each of the Five Human Emperors was to the left of his Heavenly Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the Five Human Emperors was positioned to the left of his corresponding Heavenly Emperor.

sentences.zh: 其儀如郊禮。

translations.literal: The ceremony was as at the suburban rite.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed suburban ritual practice.

sentences.zh: 堯廟，則遣使祈於平陽。

translations.literal: At the Temple of Yao, an envoy was sent to pray at Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the Temple of Yao, an envoy was dispatched to offer prayers at Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 孔、顏廟，則遣使祈于國學，如堯廟。

translations.literal: At the temples of Confucius and Yan, an envoy was sent to pray at the National Academy, as at the Temple of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: At the temples of Confucius and Yan, an envoy was sent to pray at the National Academy, following the same procedure as at the Temple of Yao.

sentences.zh: 社稷如正祭。

translations.literal: The altars of soil and grain followed the regular sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The altars of soil and grain followed the regular seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 五嶽，遣使祈于嶽所。

translations.literal: For the Five Sacred Peaks, an envoy was sent to pray at each peak.
translations.idiomatic: For the Five Sacred Peaks, an envoy was dispatched to pray at each peak's shrine.

sentences.zh: 四瀆如祈五嶽，滏口如祈堯廟，豹祠如祈滏口。

translations.literal: The Four Rivers followed the Five Peaks; Fokou followed the Temple of Yao; the Leopard Shrine followed Fokou.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Rivers followed the procedure for the Five Peaks; Fokou followed the Temple of Yao; the Leopard Shrine followed Fokou.

sentences.zh: 隋雩壇，國南十三裏啟夏門外道左。

translations.literal: The Sui rain altar stood thirteen li south of the capital, to the left of the road outside the Qixia Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui rain altar stood thirteen li south of the capital, to the left of the road outside the Qixia Gate.

sentences.zh: 高一丈，周百二十尺。

translations.literal: It was one zhang high and one hundred twenty chi in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: It was one zhang in height and one hundred twenty chi in circumference.

sentences.zh: 孟夏之月，龍星見，則雩五方上帝，配以五人帝於上，以太祖武元帝配饗，五官從配於下。

translations.literal: In the first month of summer, when the dragon star appeared, the Five Directional Heavenly Emperors were honored in the rain sacrifice, with the Five Human Emperors associated above, the Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan associated in the feast, and the Five Officials associated below.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of summer, when the dragon star appeared, the Five Directional Heavenly Emperors received the rain sacrifice, with the Five Human Emperors associated above, the Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan associated in the feast, and the Five Officials associated below.

sentences.zh: 牲用犢十，各依方色。

translations.literal: Ten calves were used as victims, each according to the color of its direction.
translations.idiomatic: Ten calves served as victims, each according to the color of its direction.

sentences.zh: 京師孟夏後旱，則祈雨，理冤獄失職，存鰥寡孤獨，振困乏，掩骼埋胔，省徭役，進賢良，舉直言，退佞諂，黜貪殘，命有司會男女，恤怨曠。

translations.literal: If after the first month of summer in the capital there was drought, rain was prayed for: wrongful imprisonments were redressed, the dismissed restored, widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary were provided for, the destitute relieved, exposed bones buried and flesh interred, corvée reduced, worthy men recommended, forthright speech promoted, flatterers dismissed, the greedy and cruel removed, officials ordered to arrange marriages, and the separated and unmarried shown concern.
translations.idiomatic: If drought persisted in the capital after the first month of summer, rain prayers were undertaken: wrongful cases were reviewed, dismissed officials restored, widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary provided for, the destitute relieved, exposed bones and flesh interred, corvée reduced, worthy men recommended, forthright speech encouraged, flatterers removed, the greedy and cruel dismissed, officials ordered to arrange marriages, and the separated and unmarried shown concern.

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈嶽鎮海瀆及諸山川能興雲雨者；

translations.literal: After seven days, the sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, and all mountains and rivers that could raise clouds and rain were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: After seven days, prayers were offered to the sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, and all mountains and rivers capable of raising clouds and rain;

sentences.zh: 又七日，乃祈社稷及古來百辟卿士有益於人者；

translations.literal: after another seven days, the altars of soil and grain and ministers and officers of antiquity who had benefited the people were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, prayers were offered at the altars of soil and grain and to ministers and officers of antiquity who had benefited the people;

sentences.zh: 又七日，乃祈宗廟及古帝王有神祠者；

translations.literal: after another seven days, the ancestral temples and ancient emperors with spirit shrines were prayed to;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, prayers were offered at the ancestral temples and to ancient emperors with established spirit shrines;

sentences.zh: 又七日，乃修雩，祈神州；

translations.literal: after another seven days, the rain sacrifice was renewed, praying to the Divine Land;
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, the rain sacrifice was renewed with prayers to the Divine Land;

sentences.zh: 又七日，仍不雨，複從嶽瀆已下祈如初典。

translations.literal: after another seven days, if rain still did not come, prayers from the sacred peaks and rivers downward were repeated according to the original precedent.
translations.idiomatic: after another seven days, if rain still had not come, prayers from the sacred peaks and rivers downward were repeated according to the original sequence.

sentences.zh: 秋分已後不雩，但禱而已。

translations.literal: After the autumn equinox the rain sacrifice was not performed; only prayers were offered.
translations.idiomatic: After the autumn equinox the full rain sacrifice was not performed; only prayers were offered.

sentences.zh: 皆用酒脯。

translations.literal: All used wine and dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: All these rites employed offerings of wine and dried meat.

sentences.zh: 初請後二旬不雨者，即徙市禁屠。

translations.literal: If after the initial petition there was no rain for twenty days, the market was moved and slaughter was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: If twenty days passed after the initial petition without rain, the market was relocated and slaughter was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 皇帝禦素服，避正殿，減膳撤樂，或露坐聽政。

translations.literal: The emperor wore plain robes, avoided the main hall, reduced his meals and suspended music, or sat in the open to conduct affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore plain robes, avoided the main hall, reduced his meals and suspended music, or sat in the open air to conduct affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 百官斷傘扇。

translations.literal: All officials ceased using parasols and fans.
translations.idiomatic: All officials ceased using parasols and fans.

sentences.zh: 令人家造土龍。

translations.literal: People in households were ordered to make clay dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Households were ordered to make clay dragons.

sentences.zh: 雨澍，則命有司報。

translations.literal: When timely rain came, officials were ordered to perform the response sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When timely rain came, officials were ordered to perform the response sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 州郡尉祈雨，則理冤獄，存鰥寡孤獨，掩骼埋胔，潔齋祈於社。

translations.literal: When prefects and commandery officials prayed for rain, they redressed wrongful imprisonments, provided for widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, buried exposed bones and flesh, purified themselves and fasted, and prayed at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: When prefects and commandery officials prayed for rain, they reviewed wrongful cases, provided for widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, interred exposed bones and flesh, purified themselves and fasted, and offered prayers at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 七日，乃祈界內山川能興雨者，徙市斷屠如京師。

translations.literal: After seven days, mountains and rivers within the jurisdiction capable of bringing rain were prayed to; the market was moved and slaughter forbidden as in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After seven days, prayers were offered to mountains and rivers within the jurisdiction capable of bringing rain, and the market was relocated and slaughter forbidden as in the capital.

sentences.zh: 祈而澍，亦各有報。

translations.literal: When prayers were answered with timely rain, each also had its response sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When prayers were answered with timely rain, each site also received its response sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 霖雨則珝京城諸門，三珝不止，則祈山川嶽鎮海瀆社稷。

translations.literal: In prolonged rain, prayers were offered at the gates of the capital; if after three prayers it did not stop, mountains, rivers, sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, and the altars of soil and grain were prayed to.
translations.idiomatic: During prolonged rain, prayers were offered at the gates of the capital; if rain did not cease after three prayers, mountains, rivers, sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, and the altars of soil and grain were invoked.

sentences.zh: 又不止，則祈宗廟神州。

translations.literal: If it still did not stop, the ancestral temples and the Divine Land were prayed to.
translations.idiomatic: If rain still did not cease, prayers were offered at the ancestral temples and to the Divine Land.

sentences.zh: 報乙太牢。

translations.literal: The response sacrifice was the secondary great offering.
translations.idiomatic: The response sacrifice employed the secondary great offering.

sentences.zh: 州郡縣苦雨，亦各珝其城門，不止則祈界內山川。

translations.literal: When commanderies, prefectures, and counties suffered prolonged rain, they also prayed at their city gates; if it did not stop, mountains and rivers within the jurisdiction were prayed to.
translations.idiomatic: When commanderies, prefectures, and counties suffered prolonged rain, they likewise prayed at their city gates; if rain did not cease, mountains and rivers within the jurisdiction were invoked.

sentences.zh: 及祈報，用羊豕。

translations.literal: For prayers and response sacrifices, sheep and pigs were used.
translations.idiomatic: Prayers and response sacrifices employed sheep and pigs as victims.

sentences.zh: 《禮》，天子每以四立之日及季夏，乘玉輅，建大旂，服大裘，各于其方之近郊為兆，迎其帝而祭之。

translations.literal: The Rites say that the Son of Heaven, on each of the four establishment days and in the last month of summer, rides the jade chariot, raises the great banner, wears the great fur robe, and at the suburban precinct nearest to each direction welcomes its emperor and sacrifices to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites prescribe that the Son of Heaven, on each of the four establishment days and in the last month of summer, rides the jade chariot, raises the great banner, wears the great fur robe, and at the suburban precinct nearest to each direction welcomes its emperor and offers sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 所謂燔柴於泰壇，掃地而祭者也。

translations.literal: This is what is meant by burning firewood on the great altar and sweeping the ground to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by burning firewood on the great altar and sweeping the ground to perform the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 春迎靈威仰者，三春之始，萬物稟之而生，莫不仰其靈德，服而畏之也。

translations.literal: In spring the Lingwei Yang is welcomed: at the beginning of the three spring months, all things receive life from it and none fail to look up to its numinous virtue, submitting to and revering it.
translations.idiomatic: In spring the Lingwei Yang is welcomed: at the opening of the three spring months, all living things receive life from it and none fail to look up to its numinous virtue, submitting to and revering it.

sentences.zh: 夏迎赤熛怒者，火色氇票怒，其靈炎至明盛也。

translations.literal: In summer the Chih Yan Nu is welcomed: fire-colored and blazing with anger, its spirit is brilliantly blazing and supremely bright.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the Chih Yan Nu is welcomed: fiery in color and blazing with wrath, its spirit burns with brilliant and supreme brightness.

sentences.zh: 秋迎白招拒者，招集，拒大也，言秋時集成萬物，其功大也。

translations.literal: In autumn the Bai Zhao Ju is welcomed: 'zhao' means to gather, 'ju' means great—meaning that in autumn all things are gathered together and its achievement is great.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn the Bai Zhao Ju is welcomed: zhao means to gather, ju means great—in autumn all things are gathered together and the achievement is great.

sentences.zh: 冬迎葉光紀者，葉拾，光華，紀法也，言冬時收拾光華之色，伏而藏之，皆有法也。

translations.literal: In winter the Ye Guang Ji is welcomed: 'ye' means to gather up, 'guang' means brilliance, 'ji' means law—meaning that in winter the brilliant colors are gathered up, stored in concealment, all according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In winter the Ye Guang Ji is welcomed: ye means to gather up, guang means brilliance, ji means law—in winter brilliant colors are gathered up and stored in concealment, all according to established law.

sentences.zh: 中迎含樞紐者，含容也，樞機有開闔之義，紐者結也。

translations.literal: At the center the Han Shu Niu is welcomed: 'han' means to contain, the pivot has the meaning of opening and closing, and 'niu' means to bind.
translations.idiomatic: At the center the Han Shu Niu is welcomed: han means to contain, the pivot has the meaning of opening and closing, and niu means to bind.

sentences.zh: 言土德之帝，能含容萬物，開闔有時，紐結有法也。

translations.literal: It means that the emperor of earth virtue can contain all things, open and close at the proper time, and bind according to law.
translations.idiomatic: This signifies that the emperor of earth virtue can contain all things, open and close at the proper season, and bind according to law.

sentences.zh: 然此五帝之號，皆以其德而名焉。

translations.literal: Yet these designations of the Five Emperors all take their names from their virtues.
translations.idiomatic: These designations of the Five Emperors all derive their names from their respective virtues.

sentences.zh: 梁、陳、後齊、後周及隋，制度相循，皆以其時之日，各於其郊迎，而乙太皞之屬五人帝配祭。

translations.literal: Liang, Chen, Later Qi, Later Zhou, and Sui all followed one another in practice; on the day of each season they welcomed at its suburb, with the Five Human Emperors such as Taihao associated in the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: Liang, Chen, Later Qi, Later Zhou, and Sui all followed one another in practice; on the day of each season they welcomed the qi at its suburban precinct, with the Five Human Emperors such as Taihao associated in the secondary offering.

sentences.zh: 並以五官、三辰、七宿于其方從祀焉。

translations.literal: The Five Officials, the Three Stars, and the Seven Lodges were also associated in sacrifice according to their directions.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Officials, the Three Stars, and the Seven Lodges were also associated in sacrifice according to their respective directions.

sentences.zh: 梁制，迎氣以始祖配，牲用特牛一，其儀同南郊。

translations.literal: Under Liang practice, in welcoming the qi the Founding Ancestor was associated; a single bull was used as victim; the ceremony was the same as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang practice, in welcoming the seasonal qi the Founding Ancestor was associated; a single bull served as victim; the ceremony followed the southern suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 天監七年，尚書左丞司馬筠等議：「以昆蟲未蟄，不以火田，鳩化為鷹，罻羅方設。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianjian, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Sima Jun and others submitted an opinion: 'Since insects have not yet awakened from hibernation, fire must not be used in the fields; when doves transform into hawks, nets and snares are just being set up.'
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianjian, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Sima Jun and others submitted an opinion: 'Since insects have not yet awakened from hibernation, fire must not be used in the fields; when doves transform into hawks, nets and snares are just being set up.'

sentences.zh: 仲春之月，祀不用牲，止珪璧皮幣。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring, sacrifices do not use victims—only jade disks, bi disks, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring, sacrifices do not employ victims—only jade disks, bi disks, and silks.

sentences.zh: 斯又事神之道，可以不殺明矣。

translations.literal: This too is the way of serving the spirits—one need not kill to make it clear.
translations.idiomatic: This too is the way of serving the spirits—killing need not be employed, as the principle is clear.

sentences.zh: 況今祀天，豈容尚此？

translations.literal: Moreover, in sacrificing to Heaven today, how can this still be permitted?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in sacrificing to Heaven today, how can the use of victims still be permitted?

sentences.zh: 請夏初迎氣，祭不用牲。

translations.literal: I request that at the beginning of summer when welcoming the qi, sacrifices not use victims.
translations.idiomatic: I request that at the beginning of summer, when welcoming the qi, sacrifices not employ victims.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 八年，明山賓議曰：「《周官》祀昊天以大裘，祀五帝亦如之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The Rites of Zhou say that in sacrificing to the August Heaven the great fur robe is worn, and in sacrificing to the Five Emperors it is likewise.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The Rites of Zhou prescribe that in sacrificing to the August Heaven the great fur robe is worn, and in sacrificing to the Five Emperors it is likewise.'

sentences.zh: 頃代郊祀之服，皆用袞冕，是以前奏迎氣、祀五帝，亦服袞冕。

translations.literal: In recent generations the robes for suburban sacrifice all used the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe; therefore in the previous memorial on welcoming the qi and sacrificing to the Five Emperors, the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe was also worn.
translations.idiomatic: In recent generations the robes for suburban sacrifice all used the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe; therefore in the previous memorial on welcoming the qi and sacrificing to the Five Emperors, the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe was also worn.

sentences.zh: 愚謂迎氣、祀五帝亦宜用大裘，禮俱一獻。

translations.literal: I hold that in welcoming the qi and sacrificing to the Five Emperors the great fur robe should also be used, with a single presentation for both rites.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that in welcoming the qi and sacrificing to the Five Emperors the great fur robe should also be worn, with a single presentation for both rites.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 陳迎氣之法，皆因梁制。

translations.literal: Chen practice for welcoming the qi all followed Liang regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Chen practice for welcoming the seasonal qi followed Liang regulations throughout.

sentences.zh: 後齊五郊迎氣，為壇各於四郊，又為黃壇於未地。

translations.literal: Later Qi, in welcoming the qi of the five seasons, made altars each at the four suburbs, and also made a yellow altar in the wei position.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi, in welcoming the qi of the five seasons, erected altars at each of the four suburbs, and also built a yellow altar in the wei position.

sentences.zh: 所祀天帝及配帝五官之神同梁。

translations.literal: The Heavenly Emperors sacrificed to and the associated emperors and Five Officials were the same as under Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Emperors sacrificed to, the associated emperors, and the Five Officials followed the same arrangement as under Liang.

sentences.zh: 其玉帛牲各以其方色。

translations.literal: The jades, silks, and victims each followed the color of their direction.
translations.idiomatic: The jades, silks, and victims each followed the color of their respective direction.

sentences.zh: 其儀與南郊同。

translations.literal: The ceremony was the same as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed the southern suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 帝及後各以夕牲日之旦，太尉陳幣，告請其廟，以就配焉。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress each, on the evening before the victim day, at dawn the Grand Commandant presented silks and reported to their temples, then proceeded to the associated offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress each, on the evening before the victim day and at dawn, the Grand Commandant presented silks and reported to their temples before proceeding to the associated offering.

sentences.zh: 其從祀之官，位皆南陛之東，西向。

translations.literal: Officials in associated sacrifice all took their places east of the southern stairway, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Officials participating in associated sacrifice all took their places east of the southern stairway, facing west.

sentences.zh: 壇上設饌畢，太宰丞設饌於其座。

translations.literal: When offerings were set on the altar, the Grand Steward's assistant set offerings at their seats.
translations.idiomatic: When offerings were set on the altar, the Grand Steward's assistant placed offerings at each seat.

sentences.zh: 亞獻畢，太常少卿乃於其所獻。

translations.literal: When the secondary presentation was complete, the Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies then made the offering at their place.
translations.idiomatic: When the secondary presentation was complete, the Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies then made the offering at the appropriate place.

sentences.zh: 事畢，皆撤。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, all were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, all offerings were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 又雲，立春前五日，於州大門外之東，造青土牛兩頭，耕夫犁具。

translations.literal: It was also said that five days before the establishment of spring, east of the great gate of the prefecture, two green clay oxen and ploughmen with ploughing implements were made.
translations.idiomatic: It was also prescribed that five days before the establishment of spring, east of the prefecture's great gate, two green clay oxen and ploughmen with ploughing implements were to be prepared.

sentences.zh: 立春，有司迎春於東郊，豎青幡于青牛之傍焉。

translations.literal: At the establishment of spring, officials welcomed spring at the eastern suburb and erected a green banner beside the green ox.
translations.idiomatic: At the establishment of spring, officials welcomed spring at the eastern suburb and erected a green banner beside the green ox.

sentences.zh: 後周五郊壇其崇及去國，如其行之數。

translations.literal: Later Zhou's five suburban altars were as high and as distant from the capital as the number of their associated direction.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou's five suburban altars were as high and as distant from the capital as the number associated with their direction.

sentences.zh: 其廣皆四丈，其方俱百二十步。

translations.literal: All were four zhang wide; each side was one hundred twenty paces.
translations.idiomatic: All were four zhang in width; each side measured one hundred twenty paces.

sentences.zh: 內壝皆半之。

translations.literal: The inner enclosures were all half that size.
translations.idiomatic: The inner enclosures were all half that size.

sentences.zh: 祭配皆同後齊。

translations.literal: Associated offerings all followed Later Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Associated offerings all followed Later Qi practice.

sentences.zh: 星辰、七宿、嶽鎮、海瀆、山林、川澤、丘陵、墳衍，亦各于其方配郊而祀之。

translations.literal: The stars, the Seven Lodges, sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, and plains were also each associated in sacrifice at their direction's suburban precinct.
translations.idiomatic: The stars, the Seven Lodges, sacred peaks, guardian mountains, seas, rivers, mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, and plains were also each associated in sacrifice at the suburban precinct of their direction.

sentences.zh: 其星辰為壇，崇五尺，方二丈。

translations.literal: For the stars an altar was made, five chi high and two zhang square.
translations.idiomatic: For the stars an altar was constructed, five chi high and two zhang square.

sentences.zh: 岳鎮為坎，方二丈，深二尺。

translations.literal: For sacred peaks and guardian mountains a pit was made, two zhang square and two chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: For sacred peaks and guardian mountains a pit was dug, two zhang square and two chi deep.

sentences.zh: 山林已下，亦為坎。

translations.literal: For mountains, forests, and below, pits were also made.
translations.idiomatic: For mountains, forests, and below, pits were likewise constructed.

sentences.zh: 壇，崇三尺，坎深一尺，俱方一丈。

translations.literal: Altars were three chi high; pits one chi deep; all one zhang square.
translations.idiomatic: Altars were three chi high; pits one chi deep; all one zhang square.

sentences.zh: 其儀頗同南郊。

translations.literal: The ceremony largely followed the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony largely followed southern suburban practice.

sentences.zh: 塚宰亞獻，宗伯終獻，禮畢。

translations.literal: The Grand Steward made the secondary presentation, the Grand Herald the final presentation, and the rite was complete.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Steward made the secondary presentation, the Grand Herald the final presentation, and the rite was concluded.

sentences.zh: 隋五時迎氣。

translations.literal: Sui welcomed the qi of the five seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Sui welcomed the qi of the five seasons.

sentences.zh: 青郊為壇，國東春明門外道北，去宮八裏。

translations.literal: The green suburban altar stood north of the road outside the Chunming Gate east of the capital, eight li from the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The green suburban altar stood north of the road outside the Chunming Gate east of the capital, eight li from the palace.

sentences.zh: 高八尺。

translations.literal: It was eight chi high.
translations.idiomatic: It was eight chi in height.

sentences.zh: 赤郊為壇，國南明德門外道西，去宮十三裏，高七尺。

translations.literal: The red suburban altar stood west of the road outside the Mingde Gate south of the capital, thirteen li from the palace, seven chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The red suburban altar stood west of the road outside the Mingde Gate south of the capital, thirteen li from the palace and seven chi high.

sentences.zh: 黃郊為壇，國南安化門外道西，去宮十二裏，高七尺。

translations.literal: The yellow suburban altar stood west of the road outside the Anhua Gate south of the capital, twelve li from the palace, seven chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow suburban altar stood west of the road outside the Anhua Gate south of the capital, twelve li from the palace and seven chi high.

sentences.zh: 白郊為壇，國西開遠門外道南，去宮八裏，高九尺。

translations.literal: The white suburban altar stood south of the road outside the Kaiyuan Gate west of the capital, eight li from the palace, nine chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The white suburban altar stood south of the road outside the Kaiyuan Gate west of the capital, eight li from the palace and nine chi high.

sentences.zh: 黑郊為壇，宮北十一裏醜地，高六尺。

translations.literal: The black suburban altar stood in the chou position eleven li north of the palace, six chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The black suburban altar stood in the chou position eleven li north of the palace, six chi high.

sentences.zh: 並廣四丈。

translations.literal: All were four zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: All were four zhang in width.

sentences.zh: 各以四方立日，黃郊以季夏土王日。

translations.literal: Each on the establishment day of its direction; the yellow suburb on the day when earth ruled in the last month of summer.
translations.idiomatic: Each rite was performed on the establishment day of its direction; the yellow suburb on the day when earth ruled in the last month of summer.

sentences.zh: 祀其方之帝，各配以人帝，以太祖武元帝配。

translations.literal: The emperor of its direction was sacrificed to, each with a Human Emperor associated; the Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan was associated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor of each direction was sacrificed to, each with a Human Emperor associated; the Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan served as associated offering.

sentences.zh: 五官及星三辰七宿，亦各依其方從祀。

translations.literal: The Five Officials and the stars, Three Stars, and Seven Lodges were also associated in sacrifice according to their directions.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Officials and the stars, Three Stars, and Seven Lodges were also associated in sacrifice according to their respective directions.

sentences.zh: 其牲依方色，各用犢二，星辰加羊豕各一。

translations.literal: Victims followed the color of each direction, two calves each; for the stars a sheep and pig were added.
translations.idiomatic: Victims followed the color of each direction, two calves each; for the stars a sheep and pig were added.

sentences.zh: 其儀同南郊。

translations.literal: The ceremony was the same as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed the southern suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 其嶽瀆鎮海，各依五時迎氣日，遣使就其所，祭之乙太牢。

translations.literal: For sacred peaks, rivers, guardian mountains, and seas, on the day of welcoming the qi of each season an envoy was sent to the site to sacrifice with the secondary great offering.
translations.idiomatic: For sacred peaks, rivers, guardian mountains, and seas, on the day of welcoming the qi of each season an envoy was dispatched to each site to sacrifice with the secondary great offering.

sentences.zh: 晉江左以後，乃至宋、齊相承，始受命之主，皆立六廟，虛太祖之位。

translations.literal: From the Jiang-zuo period onward through Song and Qi in succession, the first ruler to receive the mandate all established six temples, leaving the Founding Ancestor's place vacant.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jiang-zuo period onward through Song and Qi in succession, each first ruler to receive the mandate established six temples, leaving the Founding Ancestor's place vacant.

sentences.zh: 宋武初為宋王，立廟于彭城，但祭高祖已下四世。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Song first became Prince of Song, he established temples at Pengcheng, sacrificing only to the four generations from the High Ancestor downward.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Song first became Prince of Song, he established temples at Pengcheng, sacrificing only to the four generations from the High Ancestor downward.

sentences.zh: 中興二年，梁武初為梁公。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing, Emperor Wu of Liang first became Duke of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongxing, Emperor Wu of Liang first became Duke of Liang.

sentences.zh: 曹文思議：「天子受命之日，便祭七廟。

translations.literal: Cao Wensi submitted an opinion: 'On the day the Son of Heaven receives the mandate, he immediately sacrifices at the seven temples.'
translations.idiomatic: Cao Wensi submitted an opinion: 'On the day the Son of Heaven receives the mandate, he should immediately sacrifice at the seven temples.'

sentences.zh: 諸侯始封，即祭五廟。

translations.literal: When feudal lords are first enfeoffed, they immediately sacrifice at the five temples.
translations.idiomatic: When feudal lords are first enfeoffed, they should immediately sacrifice at the five temples.

sentences.zh: 」祠部郎謝廣等並駁之，遂不施用。

translations.literal: Xie Guang of the Sacrificial Bureau and others all refuted this, and it was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Guang of the Sacrificial Bureau and others all refuted this, and the proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 乃建台，於東城立四親廟，並妃郗氏而為五廟。

translations.literal: A platform was then built and four intimate temples established in the eastern city, with Consort Xi added to make five temples.
translations.idiomatic: A platform was then built and four intimate temples established in the eastern city, with Consort Xi added to make five temples in all.

sentences.zh: 告祠之禮，並用太牢。

translations.literal: For announcement and sacrifice the rite always used the great offering.
translations.idiomatic: For announcement and sacrifice the rite always employed the great offering.

sentences.zh: 其年四月，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year he ascended the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 謝廣又議，以為初祭是四時常祭，首月既不可移易，宜依前克日於東廟致齋。

translations.literal: Xie Guang again submitted an opinion, holding that the initial sacrifice was the regular seasonal sacrifice of the four seasons, and since the first month could not be moved, it was appropriate to follow the previous practice of choosing a day to fast at the eastern temple.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Guang again submitted an opinion, holding that the initial sacrifice was the regular seasonal sacrifice of the four seasons, and since the first month could not be moved, it was appropriate to follow the previous practice of choosing a day to fast at the eastern temple.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 遂于東城時祭訖，遷神主於太廟。

translations.literal: Thereupon the seasonal sacrifice was performed in the eastern city, and the spirit tablets were moved to the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the seasonal sacrifice was performed in the eastern city, after which the spirit tablets were moved to the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 始自皇祖太中府君、皇祖淮陰府君、皇高祖濟陰府君、皇曾祖中從事史府君、皇祖特進府君，並皇考，以為三昭三穆，凡六廟。

translations.literal: Beginning with the Grandfather Grand Director, Grandfather Huaiyin Director, Great-Grandfather Jiyin Director, Great-Great-Grandfather Attendant Secretary Director, Grandfather Special Advance Director, and the Imperial Father—making three zhao and three mu, six temples in all.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning with the Grandfather Grand Director, Grandfather Huaiyin Director, Great-Grandfather Jiyin Director, Great-Great-Grandfather Attendant Secretary Director, Grandfather Special Advance Director, and the Imperial Father—forming three zhao and three mu, six temples in all.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考為文皇帝，皇妣為德皇后，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: The Imperial Father was posthumously honored as Emperor Wen, the Imperial Mother as Empress De, with the temple name Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Father was posthumously honored as Emperor Wen, the Imperial Mother as Empress De, with the temple name Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 皇祖特進以上，皆不追尊。

translations.literal: From the Grandfather Special Advance upward, none were posthumously honored.
translations.idiomatic: From the Grandfather Special Advance upward, none received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 擬祖遷於上，而太祖之廟不毀，與六親廟為七，皆同一堂，共庭而別室。

translations.literal: It was planned that when ancestors were moved upward, the Grand Ancestor's temple would not be destroyed, making seven together with the six intimate temples—all in one hall, sharing a courtyard but with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: It was planned that when ancestors were moved upward in the sequence, the Grand Ancestor's temple would not be destroyed, making seven together with the six intimate temples—all in one hall, sharing a courtyard but with separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 春祀、夏礿、秋嘗、冬烝並臘，一歲凡五，謂之時祭。

translations.literal: Spring sacrifice, summer yue, autumn chang, winter zheng, and the year-end la—five in a year—were called seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Spring sacrifice, summer yue, autumn chang, winter zheng, and the year-end la—five in a year—were called the seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 三年一禘，五年一袷，謂之殷祭。

translations.literal: Every three years a di, every five years a xia—were called the great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years a di, every five years a xia—these were called the great sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 禘以夏，祫以冬，皆以功臣配。

translations.literal: Di was in summer, xia in winter; both had meritorious ministers associated.
translations.idiomatic: The di was performed in summer, the xia in winter; both included meritorious ministers as associated offerings.

sentences.zh: 其儀頗同南郊。

translations.literal: The ceremony largely followed the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony largely followed southern suburban practice.

sentences.zh: 又有小廟，太祖太夫人廟也。

translations.literal: There was also a small temple—the temple of the Grand Ancestor's Grand Lady.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a small temple—the temple of the Grand Ancestor's Grand Lady.

sentences.zh: 非嫡，故別立廟。

translations.literal: Because she was not the principal consort, a separate temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: Because she was not the principal consort, a separate temple was established.

sentences.zh: 皇帝每祭太廟訖，乃詣小廟，亦以一太牢，如太廟禮。

translations.literal: Each time the emperor sacrificed at the Grand Temple, he then went to the small temple, also using one great offering, as at the Grand Temple rite.
translations.idiomatic: Each time the emperor sacrificed at the Grand Temple, he then proceeded to the small temple, also using one great offering, following Grand Temple ritual.

sentences.zh: 天監三年，尚書左丞何佟之議曰：「禘于首夏，物皆未成，故為小。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianjian, Left Assistant Director He Tongzhi submitted an opinion: 'Di at the beginning of summer—things are not yet fully formed, therefore it is lesser.'
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianjian, Left Assistant Director He Tongzhi submitted an opinion: 'The di at the beginning of summer comes when things are not yet fully formed, therefore it is the lesser rite.'

sentences.zh: 祫于秋冬，萬物皆成，其禮尤大。

translations.literal: Xia in autumn and winter—all things are complete, and its rite is especially great.
translations.idiomatic: The xia in autumn and winter comes when all things are complete, and its rite is especially great.

sentences.zh: 司勳列功臣有六，皆祭於大烝，知祫尤大，乃及之也。

translations.literal: The Director of Merits listed six meritorious ministers, all sacrificed to at the great winter zheng—knowing that the xia is especially great and therefore includes them.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Merits listed six meritorious ministers, all sacrificed to at the great winter zheng—showing that the xia is especially great and therefore includes them.

sentences.zh: 近代禘祫，並不及功臣，有乖典制。

translations.literal: In recent times di and xia both excluded meritorious ministers—contrary to canonical practice.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times both the di and xia excluded meritorious ministers—contrary to canonical practice.

sentences.zh: 宜改。

translations.literal: This should be changed.
translations.idiomatic: This should be changed.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 自是祫祭乃及功臣。

translations.literal: From this time the xia sacrifice included meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: From this time the xia sacrifice included meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 是歲，都令史王景之，列自江左以來，郊廟祭祀，帝已入齋，百姓尚哭，以為乖禮。

translations.literal: That year, Capital Commandery Clerk Wang Jingzhi listed that since the Jiang-zuo period, at suburban and temple sacrifices, after the emperor had entered fasting the common people still wept—held to be contrary to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Capital Commandery Clerk Wang Jingzhi reported that since the Jiang-zuo period, at suburban and temple sacrifices, the common people continued to weep even after the emperor had entered fasting—deemed contrary to ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 佟之等奏：「案《禮》國門在皋門外，今之籬門是也。

translations.literal: He Tongzhi and others memorialized: 'According to the Rites, the national gate is outside the inner gate; today's fence gate is this.'
translations.idiomatic: He Tongzhi and others memorialized: 'According to the Rites, the national gate stands outside the inner gate; today's fence gate corresponds to this.'

sentences.zh: 今古殊制，若禁凶服不得入籬門為太遠，宜以六門為斷。

translations.literal: Ancient and modern systems differ; if forbidding mourning dress from entering the fence gate is too distant, it is appropriate to use the six gates as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient and modern systems differ; if forbidding mourning dress from entering the fence gate sets the boundary too far out, the six gates should serve as the limit instead.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「六門之內，士庶甚多，四時烝嘗，俱斷其哭。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'Within the six gates there are many commoners and gentry; at the four seasonal zheng and chang sacrifices, all weeping should be forbidden.'
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed: 'Within the six gates there are many commoners and gentry; at the four seasonal zheng and chang sacrifices, all weeping should be forbidden.'

sentences.zh: 若有死者，棺器須來，既許其大，而不許其細也。

translations.literal: If there are the dead, coffins and vessels must come—having permitted the greater, one cannot forbid the lesser.
translations.idiomatic: If there are the dead, coffins and vessels must be admitted—having permitted the greater matter, one cannot forbid the lesser.

sentences.zh: 到齋日，宜去廟二百步斷哭。

translations.literal: On the day of fasting, weeping should be forbidden two hundred paces from the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of fasting, weeping should be forbidden within two hundred paces of the temple.

sentences.zh: 」四年，何佟之議：「案《禮》未祭一日，大宗伯省牲鑊，祭日之晨，君親牽牲麗碑。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, He Tongzhi submitted an opinion: 'According to the Rites, one day before the sacrifice the Grand Herald inspects the victim and cauldron; on the morning of the sacrifice day the ruler personally leads the victim past the stone tablet.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, He Tongzhi submitted an opinion: 'According to the Rites, one day before the sacrifice the Grand Herald inspects the victim and cauldron; on the morning of the sacrifice day the ruler personally leads the victim past the stone tablet.'

sentences.zh: 後代有冒暗之防，而人主猶必親奉，故有夕牲之禮。

translations.literal: Later generations had precautions against darkness, yet the ruler still had to perform personally; therefore there was the evening-victim rite.
translations.idiomatic: Later generations had precautions against darkness, yet the ruler still had to perform in person; therefore the evening-victim rite was established.

sentences.zh: 頃代人君，不復躬牽，相承丹陽尹牽牲，于古無取。

translations.literal: In recent generations rulers no longer led the victim personally; the Director of Danyang leading the victim was handed down without precedent in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In recent generations rulers no longer led the victim in person; the Director of Danyang leading the victim was a practice without precedent in antiquity.

sentences.zh: 宜依以未祭一日之暮，太常省牲視鑊，祭日之晨，使太尉牽牲出入也。

translations.literal: It is appropriate to follow the practice of the evening before the sacrifice, when the Grand Master of Ceremonies inspects the victim and cauldron, and on the morning of the sacrifice day have the Grand Commandant lead the victim in and out.
translations.idiomatic: It is appropriate to follow the practice of the evening before the sacrifice, when the Grand Master of Ceremonies inspects the victim and cauldron, and on the morning of the sacrifice day have the Grand Commandant lead the victim in and out.

sentences.zh: 少牢饋食，殺牲於廟門外，今《儀注》詣廚烹牲，謂宜儀舊。

translations.literal: In the secondary offering feast, the victim is killed outside the temple gate; today the ritual text says 'proceed to the kitchen to cook the victim'—I hold that the old procedure should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the secondary offering feast, the victim is killed outside the temple gate; today the ritual text says 'proceed to the kitchen to cook the victim'—I hold that the old procedure should be followed.

sentences.zh: 」帝可其奏。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this memorial.

sentences.zh: 佟之又曰：「鄭玄雲：'天子諸侯之祭禮，先有裸屍之事，乃迎牲。

translations.literal: He Tongzhi also said: 'Zheng Xuan says: In the sacrificial rites of Son of Heaven and feudal lords, there is first the libation over the corpse, then the victim is welcomed.'
translations.idiomatic: He Tongzhi also said: 'Zheng Xuan says: In the sacrificial rites of Son of Heaven and feudal lords, there is first the libation over the corpse, then the victim is welcomed.'

sentences.zh: '今《儀注》乃至薦熟畢，太祝方執珪瓚裸地，違謬若斯。

translations.literal: Today the ritual text goes so far as to complete the presentation of cooked offerings before the Grand Invoker holds the jade cup and libation vessel for the ground libation—an error as grave as this.
translations.idiomatic: Today the ritual text goes so far as to complete the presentation of cooked offerings before the Grand Invoker holds the jade cup and libation vessel for the ground libation—an error as grave as this.

sentences.zh: 又近代人君，不復躬行裸禮。

translations.literal: Moreover, in recent generations rulers no longer personally perform the libation rite.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in recent generations rulers no longer personally perform the libation rite.

sentences.zh: 太尉既攝位，實宜親執其事，而越使卑賤太祝，甚乖舊典。

translations.literal: Since the Grand Commandant holds the position in proxy, he should properly perform this himself; yet he passes it to the lowly Grand Invoker—greatly contrary to the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Grand Commandant holds the position in proxy, he should properly perform this himself; yet he passes it to the lowly Grand Invoker—greatly contrary to the old canon.

sentences.zh: 愚謂祭日之晨，宜使太尉先行裸獻，乃後迎牲。

translations.literal: I hold that on the morning of the sacrifice day the Grand Commandant should first perform the libation presentation, and afterward welcome the victim.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that on the morning of the sacrifice day the Grand Commandant should first perform the libation presentation, and afterward welcome the victim.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「裸屍本使神有所附。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'The libation over the corpse originally enabled the spirit to have something to attach to.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'The libation over the corpse originally enabled the spirit to have something to attach to.'

sentences.zh: 今既無屍，裸將安設？

translations.literal: Now that there is no corpse, where is the libation to be set?
translations.idiomatic: Now that there is no corpse, where is the libation to be set?

sentences.zh: 」佟之曰「如馬、鄭之意，裸雖獻屍，而義在求神。

translations.literal: He Tongzhi said: 'According to Ma and Zheng's meaning, though the libation is presented to the corpse, its purpose is to seek the spirit.'
translations.idiomatic: He Tongzhi said: 'According to Ma and Zheng's meaning, though the libation is presented to the corpse, its purpose is to seek the spirit.'

sentences.zh: 今雖無屍，求神之義， 恐不可闕。

translations.literal: Though there is now no corpse, the meaning of seeking the spirit—I fear it cannot be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Though there is now no corpse, the meaning of seeking the spirit—I fear it cannot be omitted.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此本因屍以祀神。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'This originally depended on the corpse to sacrifice to the spirit.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'This originally depended on the corpse to sacrifice to the spirit.'

sentences.zh: 今若無屍，則宜立寄求之所。

translations.literal: Now if there is no corpse, a place for the spirit to attach should be established.
translations.idiomatic: Now if there is no corpse, a place for the spirit to attach should be established.

sentences.zh: 」裸義乃定。

translations.literal: The meaning of the libation was thus settled.
translations.idiomatic: The meaning of the libation was thus settled.

sentences.zh: 佟之曰：「《祭統》雲：'獻之屬，莫重於裸。

translations.literal: He Tongzhi said: 'The Record of Sacrifice says: Among the presentations, none is weightier than the libation.'
translations.idiomatic: He Tongzhi said: 'The Record of Sacrifice says: Among the presentations, none is weightier than the libation.'

sentences.zh: '今既存屍卒食之獻，則裸鬯之求，實不可闕。

translations.literal: Now that the presentations to the corpse at the end of the feast are retained, the libation of fragrant wine to seek the spirit truly cannot be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the presentations to the corpse at the end of the feast are retained, the libation of fragrant wine to seek the spirit truly cannot be omitted.

sentences.zh: 又送神更裸，經記無文，宜依禮革。

translations.literal: Moreover, performing another libation when sending off the spirit has no text in the classics—I hold it should be abolished according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, performing another libation when sending off the spirit has no text in the classics—I hold it should be abolished according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 」奏未報而佟之卒。

translations.literal: The memorial received no response before He Tongzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial received no response before He Tongzhi died.

sentences.zh: 後明山賓複申其理。

translations.literal: Later Ming Shanbin again submitted this reasoning.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ming Shanbin again submitted this reasoning.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「佟之既不復存，宜從其議也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Since He Tongzhi is no longer alive, his opinion should be followed.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'Since He Tongzhi is no longer alive, his opinion should be followed.'

sentences.zh: 」自是始使太尉代太祝行裸而又牽牲。

translations.literal: From this time the Grand Commandant was first made to perform the libation in place of the Grand Invoker and also to lead the victim.
translations.idiomatic: From this time the Grand Commandant was made to perform the libation in place of the Grand Invoker and also to lead the victim.

sentences.zh: 太常任昉又以未明九刻呈牲，又加太尉裸酒，三刻施饌，間中五刻，行儀不辦。

translations.literal: Ren Fang of the Grand Master of Ceremonies also held that presenting the victim at the ninth quarter before dawn, adding the Grand Commandant's libation wine, setting out offerings at the third quarter, with the rite not completed by the middle fifth quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Fang of the Grand Master of Ceremonies also held that presenting the victim at the ninth quarter before dawn, adding the Grand Commandant's libation wine, and setting out offerings at the third quarter left the rite incomplete by the middle fifth quarter.

sentences.zh: 近者臨祭從事，實以二更，至未明三刻方辦。

translations.literal: Recently in approaching the sacrifice, in practice it was at the second watch, and only at the third quarter before dawn was it completed.
translations.idiomatic: Recently in approaching the sacrifice, in practice it began at the second watch, and only at the third quarter before dawn was the rite completed.

sentences.zh: 明山賓議：「謂九刻已疑太早，況二更非複祭旦。

translations.literal: Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The ninth quarter is already suspected to be too early—how much more the second watch, which is no longer the morning of sacrifice.'
translations.idiomatic: Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The ninth quarter is already suspected to be too early—how much more the second watch, which is no longer the morning of sacrifice.'

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「夜半子時，即是晨始。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Midnight, the zi hour, is already the beginning of morning.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'Midnight, the zi hour, is already the beginning of morning.'

sentences.zh: 宜取三更省牲，餘依《儀注》。

translations.literal: The third watch should be taken for inspecting the victim; the remainder should follow the ritual text.
translations.idiomatic: The third watch should be taken for inspecting the victim; the remainder should follow the ritual text.

sentences.zh: 」又有司以為三牲或離杙，依制埋瘞，豬羊死則不埋。

translations.literal: The relevant officials also held that among the three victims one might be separated from its tether; according to regulation it should be buried—if pigs and sheep died they were not buried.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant officials also held that among the three victims one might be separated from its tether; according to regulation it should be buried—if pigs and sheep died they were not buried.

sentences.zh: 請議其制。

translations.literal: They requested discussion of this regulation.
translations.idiomatic: They requested discussion of this regulation.

sentences.zh: 司馬褧等議，以為「牲死則埋，必在滌矣。

translations.literal: Sima Rong and others submitted an opinion, holding that 'when the victim dies it is buried—it must be at the washing pen.'
translations.idiomatic: Sima Rong and others submitted an opinion, holding that 'when the victim dies it is buried—it must be at the washing pen.'

sentences.zh: 謂三牲在滌，死悉宜埋。

translations.literal: I hold that the three victims in the washing pen, if dead, should all be buried.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that the three victims in the washing pen, if dead, should all be buried.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 五年，明山賓議：「樽彝之制，《祭圖》唯有三樽：一曰象樽，周樽也；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The regulations for zun and yi vessels—the Sacrificial Diagram has only three zun: first, the elephant zun, the Zhou zun;'
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Ming Shanbin submitted an opinion: 'The regulations for zun and yi vessels—the Sacrificial Diagram has only three zun: first, the elephant zun, the Zhou zun;'

sentences.zh: 二曰山罍，夏樽也；

translations.literal: second, the mountain lei, the Xia zun;
translations.idiomatic: second, the mountain lei, the Xia zun;

sentences.zh: 三曰著樽，殷樽也。

translations.literal: third, the zhuo zun, the Yin zun.
translations.idiomatic: third, the zhuo zun, the Yin zun.

sentences.zh: 徒有彝名，竟無其器，直酌象樽之酒，以為珪瓚之實。

translations.literal: There is only the name yi, but no actual vessel; wine from the elephant zun alone is poured as the substance of the jade cup libation.
translations.idiomatic: There is only the name yi, but no actual vessel; wine from the elephant zun alone is poured as the substance of the jade cup libation.

sentences.zh: 竊尋裸重於獻，不容共樽，宜循彝器，以備大典。

translations.literal: I hold that the libation is weightier than the presentation and cannot share a zun—it is appropriate to follow the yi vessels to complete the great canon.
