translations.idiomatic: I hold that the libation is weightier than the presentation and cannot share a zun—it is appropriate to follow the yi vessels to complete the great canon.

sentences.zh: 案禮器有六彝，春祠夏礿，裸用雞彝鳥彝。

translations.literal: According to the ritual vessels there are six yi; in spring sacrifice and summer yue, the libation uses the ji yi and niao yi.
translations.idiomatic: According to the ritual vessels there are six yi; in spring sacrifice and summer yue, the libation uses the ji yi and niao yi.

sentences.zh: 王以珪瓚初裸，後以璋瓚亞裸，故春夏兩祭，俱用二彝。

translations.literal: The king with the jade cup performs the initial libation, afterward with the zhang cup the secondary libation—therefore in the two sacrifices of spring and summer, both use two yi.
translations.idiomatic: The king with the jade cup performs the initial libation, afterward with the zhang cup the secondary libation—therefore in the two sacrifices of spring and summer, both use two yi.

sentences.zh: 今古禮殊，無複亞裸，止循其二。

translations.literal: Ancient and modern ritual differ; there is no longer a secondary libation—only these two should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient and modern ritual differ; there is no longer a secondary libation—only these two should be followed.

sentences.zh: 春夏雞彝，秋冬牛彝，庶禮物備也。

translations.literal: In spring and summer the ji yi, in autumn and winter the niu yi—then the ritual objects would be complete.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and summer the ji yi, in autumn and winter the niu yi—then the ritual objects would be complete.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「雞是金禽，亦主巽位。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'The ji is a metal bird and also governs the xun position.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'The ji is a metal bird and also governs the xun position.'

sentences.zh: 但金火相伏，用之通夏，於義為疑。

translations.literal: But metal and fire mutually subdue each other; using it through summer is doubtful in meaning.
translations.idiomatic: But metal and fire mutually subdue each other; using it through summer is doubtful in meaning.

sentences.zh: 」山賓曰：「臣愚管，不奉明詔，則終年乖舛。

translations.literal: Shanbin said: 'My humble understanding, without receiving the clear edict, would err throughout the year.'
translations.idiomatic: Shanbin said: 'My humble understanding, without receiving the clear edict, would err throughout the year.'

sentences.zh: 案鳥彝是南方之物，則主火位，木生於火，宜以鳥彝春夏兼用。

translations.literal: According to the niao yi, it is a thing of the southern direction and governs the fire position; wood is generated from fire—it is appropriate to use the niao yi in both spring and summer.
translations.idiomatic: According to the niao yi, it is a thing of the southern direction and governs the fire position; wood is generated from fire—it is appropriate to use the niao yi in both spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 七年，舍人周舍以為：「《禮》「玉輅以祀，金輅以賓'，則祭日應乘玉輅。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Attendant Zhou She held: 'The Rites say "the jade chariot for sacrifice, the gold chariot for guest reception"—therefore on the sacrifice day one should ride the jade chariot.'
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Attendant Zhou She held: 'The Rites say "the jade chariot for sacrifice, the gold chariot for guest reception"—therefore on the sacrifice day one should ride the jade chariot.'

sentences.zh: 」詔下其議。

translations.literal: An edict was issued for discussion of this opinion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued for discussion of this opinion.

sentences.zh: 左丞孔休源議：「玉輅既有明文，而《儀注》金輅，當由宋、齊乖謬，宜依舍議。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director Kong Xiuyuan submitted an opinion: 'The jade chariot has clear text, while the ritual text has the gold chariot—this must be due to Song and Qi error; She's opinion should be followed.'
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Director Kong Xiuyuan submitted an opinion: 'The jade chariot has clear textual authority, while the ritual text specifies the gold chariot—this must be due to Song and Qi error; She's opinion should be followed.'

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 又禮官司馬筠議：「自今大事，遍告七廟，小事止告一室。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Bureau's Sima Jun also submitted an opinion: 'From now on, for great affairs, report to all seven temples; for small affairs, report to one chamber only.'
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Bureau's Sima Jun also submitted an opinion: 'From now on, for great affairs, report to all seven temples; for small affairs, report to one chamber only.'

sentences.zh: 」於是議以封禪，南、北郊，祀明堂，巡省四方，禦臨戎出征，皇太子加元服，寇賊平蕩，築宮立闕，纂戎戒嚴、解嚴，合十一條，則遍告七廟。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decided that for feng and shan, southern and northern suburbs, Bright Hall sacrifice, touring the four directions, personally leading campaigns, the Crown Prince's capping, suppressing bandits, building palaces and gates—eleven items in all—report to all seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon it was decided that for feng and shan, southern and northern suburbs, Bright Hall sacrifice, touring the four directions, personally leading campaigns, the Crown Prince's capping, suppressing bandits, building palaces and gates—eleven items in all—report should be made to all seven temples.

sentences.zh: 講武，修宗廟明堂，臨軒封拜公王，四夷款化貢方物，諸公王以愆削封，及詔封王紹襲，合六條，則告一室。

translations.literal: Military reviews, repairing the ancestral temple and Bright Hall, enthronement investiture of dukes and princes, submission and tribute from the four barbarians, enfeoffment and succession of princes, reduction or restoration of noble ranks—six items—report to one chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Military reviews, repairing the ancestral temple and Bright Hall, enthronement investiture of dukes and princes, submission and tribute from the four barbarians, enfeoffment and succession of princes, reduction or restoration of noble ranks—six items—report should be made to one chamber.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔簠簋之實，以藉田黑黍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict said that the substance of the fu and gui vessels should use black millet from the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, an edict prescribed that the substance of the fu and gui vessels should use black millet from the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 十二年，詔曰：「祭祀用洗■中水盥，仍又滌爵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, an edict said: 'In sacrifice, water from the washing vessel is used for hand-washing, and afterward the cups are rinsed.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, an edict said: 'In sacrifice, water from the washing vessel is used for hand-washing, and afterward the cups are rinsed.'

sentences.zh: 爵以禮神，宜窮精潔，而一器之內，雜用洗手，外可詳議。

translations.literal: The cups serve to honor the spirits and should attain utmost purity—yet within one vessel, hand-washing water is mixed in; this may be discussed in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The cups serve to honor the spirits and should attain utmost purity—yet within one vessel, hand-washing water is mixed in; this may be discussed in detail.

sentences.zh: 」於是禦及三公應盥及洗爵，各用一■。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor and the Three Excellencies who washed and those who rinsed cups each used one vessel.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor and the Three Excellencies who washed and those who rinsed cups each used a separate vessel.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月，詔曰：「夫神無常饗，饗於克誠，所以西鄰礿祭，實受其福。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, an edict said: 'Spirits have no fixed feasting; they feast on sincerity attained—therefore the western neighbor's yue sacrifice truly received its blessing.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, an edict said: 'Spirits have no fixed feasting; they feast on sincerity attained—therefore the western neighbor's yue sacrifice truly received its blessing.'

sentences.zh: 宗廟祭祀，猶有牲牢，無益至誠，有累冥道。

translations.literal: Ancestral temple sacrifices still use victims—without benefit to utmost sincerity, with harm to the dark way.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral temple sacrifices still use victims—without benefit to utmost sincerity, with harm to the dark way.

sentences.zh: 自今四時烝嘗外，可量代。

translations.literal: Apart from the four seasonal zheng and chang, substitutes may be used as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the four seasonal zheng and chang, substitutes may be used as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」八座議：「以大脯代一元大武。

translations.literal: The Eight Seats submitted an opinion: 'Use large dried meat in place of one yuan dawu.'
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Seats submitted an opinion: 'Use large dried meat in place of one yuan dawu.'

sentences.zh: 」八座又奏：「既停宰殺，無複省牲之事，請立省饌儀。

translations.literal: The Eight Seats also memorialized: 'Since slaughter has ceased, there is no longer the matter of inspecting victims—an rite for inspecting offerings should be established.'
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Seats also memorialized: 'Since slaughter has ceased, there is no longer the matter of inspecting victims—an rite for inspecting offerings should be established.'

sentences.zh: 其眾官陪列，並同省牲。

translations.literal: Officials in attendance in the accompanying ranks all likewise inspected offerings as they had inspected victims.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in attendance in the accompanying ranks all likewise inspected offerings as they had inspected victims.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 十月 ，詔曰：「今雖無複牲腥，猶有脯修之類，即之幽明，義為未盡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict said: 'Though there are no longer raw victims, there are still dried meat and prepared foods—in relation to the dark and bright realms, the meaning is not complete.'
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, an edict said: 'Though there are no longer raw victims, there are still dried meat and prepared foods—in relation to the dark and bright realms, the meaning is not complete.'

sentences.zh: 可更詳定，悉薦時蔬。

translations.literal: This should be discussed in further detail; all should offer seasonal vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: This should be discussed in further detail; all should offer seasonal vegetables.

sentences.zh: 」左丞司馬筠等參議：「大餅代大脯，餘悉用蔬菜。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director Sima Jun and others jointly submitted an opinion: 'Large cakes replace large dried meat; the remainder all use vegetables.'
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Director Sima Jun and others jointly submitted an opinion: 'Large cakes replace large dried meat; the remainder all use vegetables.'

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 又舍人硃異議：「二廟祀，相承止有一钅幵羹，蓋祭祀之禮，應有兩羹，相承止於一钅幵，即禮為乖。

translations.literal: Attendant Zhu Yi also submitted an opinion: 'In the two-temple sacrifice, only one pot of meat broth was handed down—sacrificial ritual should have two broths; handing down only one pot is contrary to ritual.'
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zhu Yi also submitted an opinion: 'In the two-temple sacrifice, only one pot of meat broth was handed down—sacrificial ritual should have two broths; handing down only one pot is contrary to ritual.'

sentences.zh: 請加熬油羹一钅幵。

translations.literal: I request adding one pot of stewed oil broth.
translations.idiomatic: I request adding one pot of stewed oil broth.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this proposal.

sentences.zh: 於是起至敬殿、景陽臺，立七廟座。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Hall of Utmost Reverence and the Jingyang Platform were built, with seats for the seven temples established.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Hall of Utmost Reverence and the Jingyang Platform were built, with seats for the seven temples established.

sentences.zh: 月中再設淨饌。

translations.literal: Twice a month pure offerings were set out.
translations.idiomatic: Twice a month pure offerings were set out.

sentences.zh: 自是訖於台城破，諸廟遂不血食。

translations.literal: From this until the fall of Taicheng, the temples received no blood offerings.
translations.idiomatic: From this until the fall of Taicheng, the temples received no blood offerings.

sentences.zh: 普通七年，祔皇太子所生丁貴嬪神主於小廟。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Putong, the spirit tablet of the Crown Prince's birth-mother Consort Ding was enshrined in the small temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Putong, the spirit tablet of the Crown Prince's birth-mother Consort Ding was enshrined in the small temple.

sentences.zh: 其儀，未祔前，先修坎室，改塗。

translations.literal: The ceremony: before enshrinement, the pit chamber was first repaired and replastered.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony: before enshrinement, the pit chamber was first repaired and replastered.

sentences.zh: 其日，有司行掃除，開坎室，奉皇考太夫人神主于坐。

translations.literal: On that day, officials swept and cleaned, opened the pit chamber, and placed the Imperial Father's Grand Lady's spirit tablet on the seat.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, officials swept and cleaned, opened the pit chamber, and placed the Imperial Father's Grand Lady's spirit tablet on the seat.

sentences.zh: 奠制幣訖，眾官入自東門，位定，祝告訖，撤幣，埋於兩楹間。

translations.literal: When the presentation silks were set out and the rite complete, all officials entered from the east gate, took their places, and when the invocation was complete the silks were withdrawn and buried between the two pillars.
translations.idiomatic: When the presentation silks were set out and the rite complete, all officials entered from the east gate, took their places, and when the invocation was complete the silks were withdrawn and buried between the two pillars.

sentences.zh: 有司遷太夫人神主于上，又奉穆貴嬪神主于下，陳祭器，如時祭儀。

translations.literal: Officials moved the Grand Lady's spirit tablet upward and placed Consort Mu's spirit tablet below, set out sacrificial vessels, as in the seasonal sacrifice rite.
translations.idiomatic: Officials moved the Grand Lady's spirit tablet upward and placed Consort Mu's spirit tablet below, set out sacrificial vessels, following the seasonal sacrifice rite.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，納神主，閉於坎室。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the spirit tablets were stored and the pit chamber closed.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, the spirit tablets were stored and the pit chamber closed.

sentences.zh: 陳制，立七廟，一歲五祠，謂春夏秋冬臘也。

translations.literal: Under Chen practice, seven temples were established; five sacrifices in a year—spring, summer, autumn, winter, and la.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chen practice, seven temples were established; five sacrifices in a year—spring, summer, autumn, winter, and la.

sentences.zh: 每祭共以一太牢，始祖以三牲首，餘唯骨體而已。

translations.literal: Each sacrifice used one great offering together; the Founding Ancestor received the heads of three victims; the remainder received only bones and flesh.
translations.idiomatic: Each sacrifice used one great offering together; the Founding Ancestor received the heads of three victims; the remainder received only bones and flesh.

sentences.zh: 五歲再殷，殷大祫而合祭也。

translations.literal: Every five years the great xia was performed; the great xia and xia combined the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Every five years the great xia was performed; the great xia and xia combined the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 初，文帝入嗣，而皇考始興昭烈王廟在始興國，謂之東廟。

translations.literal: Initially, when Emperor Wen entered the succession, the temple of the Imperial Father, Prince Zhaolie of Shixing, was in the kingdom of Shixing and was called the Eastern Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when Emperor Wen entered the succession, the temple of the Imperial Father, Prince Zhaolie of Shixing, stood in the kingdom of Shixing and was called the Eastern Temple.

sentences.zh: 天嘉四年，徙東廟神主，祔于梁之小廟，改曰國廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancheng, the Eastern Temple spirit tablets were moved and enshrined in Liang's small temple, renamed the State Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tiancheng, the Eastern Temple spirit tablets were moved and enshrined in Liang's small temple, renamed the State Temple.

sentences.zh: 祭用天子儀。

translations.literal: Sacrifice used Son of Heaven ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice followed Son of Heaven ritual.

sentences.zh: 後齊文襄嗣位，猶為魏臣，置王高祖秦州使君、王曾祖太尉武貞公、王祖太師文穆公、王考相國獻武王，凡四廟。

translations.literal: When Wenxiang succeeded to the position, he was still a minister of Wei; he established temples to the Wang family's Great-Great-Grandfather Qinzhou Envoy, Great-Grandfather Grand Commandant Wuzhen Duke, Grandfather Grand Master Wenmu Duke, and Imperial Father Chancellor Xianwu King—four temples in all.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenxiang succeeded to the position, he was still a minister of Wei; he established temples to the Wang family's Great-Great-Grandfather Qinzhou Envoy, Great-Grandfather Grand Commandant Wuzhen Duke, Grandfather Grand Master Wenmu Duke, and Imperial Father Chancellor Xianwu King—four temples in all.

sentences.zh: 文宣帝受禪，置六廟：曰皇祖司空公廟、皇祖吏部尚書廟、皇祖秦州使君廟、皇祖文穆皇帝廟、太祖獻武皇帝廟、世宗文襄皇帝廟，為六廟。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenxuan received the abdication, six temples were established: the temple of the Grand Ancestor Director of Works, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Director of the Masters of Writing, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Qinzhou Envoy, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenmu, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu, and the temple of the Imperial Ancestor Emperor Wenxiang—six temples.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenxuan received the abdication, six temples were established: the temple of the Grand Ancestor Director of Works, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Director of the Masters of Writing, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Qinzhou Envoy, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenmu, the temple of the Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu, and the temple of the Imperial Ancestor Emperor Wenxiang—six temples in all.

sentences.zh: 獻武已下不毀，已上則遞毀。

translations.literal: From Xianwu downward they were not destroyed; above that they were moved in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: From Xianwu downward the temples were not destroyed; above that they were moved upward in sequence.

sentences.zh: 並同廟而別室。

translations.literal: From Xianwu downward they were not destroyed; above that they were moved in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: From Xianwu downward the temples were not destroyed; above that they were moved upward in sequence.

sentences.zh: 既而遷神主於太廟。

translations.literal: All shared one temple but with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: All shared one temple hall but with separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 文襄文宣，並太祖之子，文宣初疑其昭穆之次，欲別立廟。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the spirit tablets were moved to the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the spirit tablets were moved to the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 眾議不同。

translations.literal: Wenxiang and Wenxuan were both sons of the Grand Ancestor; at first Wenxuan doubted their zhao-mu sequence and wished to establish a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiang and Wenxuan were both sons of the Grand Ancestor; at first Wenxuan doubted their zhao-mu sequence and wished to establish a separate temple.

sentences.zh: 至二年秋，始祔太廟。

translations.literal: Collective opinion differed.
translations.idiomatic: Collective opinion differed.

sentences.zh: 春祠、夏礿、秋嘗、冬烝，皆以孟月，並臘，凡五祭。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year they were first enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year they were first enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 禘祫如梁之制。

translations.literal: Spring sacrifice, summer yue, autumn chang, winter zheng, and la—all in the first month of each season—five sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Spring sacrifice, summer yue, autumn chang, winter zheng, and la—all in the first month of each season—five sacrifices in all.

sentences.zh: 每祭，室一太牢，始以皇后預祭。

translations.literal: Di and xia followed Liang practice.
translations.idiomatic: The di and xia followed Liang practice.

sentences.zh: 河清定令，四時祭廟禘祭及元日廟庭，並設庭燎二所。

translations.literal: At each sacrifice one great offering per chamber; the empress first participated in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At each sacrifice one great offering was used per chamber; the empress first participated in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 王及五等開國，執事官、散官從三品已上，皆祀五世。

translations.literal: In the Heqing regulations, at the four seasonal temple sacrifices, di sacrifice, and New Year's temple court, two courtyard fires were set up.
translations.idiomatic: In the Heqing regulations, at the four seasonal temple sacrifices, di sacrifice, and New Year's temple court, two courtyard fires were set up.

sentences.zh: 五等散品及執事官、散官正三品已下從五品已上，祭三世。

translations.literal: Princes and those of fifth rank and enfeoffed states, active officials and honorary officials from third rank upward—all sacrificed to five generations.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and those of fifth rank and enfeoffed states, active officials and honorary officials from third rank upward—all sacrificed to five generations.

sentences.zh: 三品已上，牲用一太牢，五品已下，少牢。

translations.literal: Those of fifth rank honorary and active officials from third rank downward to fifth rank upward—sacrificed to three generations.
translations.idiomatic: Those of fifth rank honorary and active officials from third rank downward to fifth rank upward—sacrificed to three generations.

sentences.zh: 執事官正六品已下，從七品已上，祭二世，用特牲。

translations.literal: From third rank upward, victims were one great offering; from fifth rank downward, the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: From third rank upward, victims were one great offering; from fifth rank downward, the secondary offering.

sentences.zh: 正八品已下，達于庶人，祭於寢，牲用特肫，或亦祭祖禰。

translations.literal: Active officials from sixth rank downward to seventh rank upward—sacrificed to two generations, using a single victim; from eighth rank downward to commoners—sacrificed in the sleeping chamber, using a single shank, or also sacrificing to grandfather and father.
translations.idiomatic: Active officials from sixth rank downward to seventh rank upward—sacrificed to two generations, using a single victim; from eighth rank downward to commoners—sacrificed in the sleeping chamber, using a single shank, or also sacrificing to grandfather and father.

sentences.zh: 諸廟悉依其宅堂之制，其間數各依廟多少為限。

translations.literal: All temples followed the system of their residential halls; the number of chambers was limited according to the number of temples.
translations.idiomatic: All temples followed the system of their residential halls; the number of chambers was limited according to the number of temples.

sentences.zh: 其牲皆子孫見官之牲。

translations.literal: Victims were all from the descendants' current official rank.
translations.idiomatic: Victims were all determined by the descendants' current official rank.

sentences.zh: 後周之制，思復古之道，乃右宗廟而左社稷。

translations.literal: Later Zhou's system, seeking to restore ancient ways, placed the ancestral temple on the right and the altars of soil and grain on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou's system, seeking to restore ancient ways, placed the ancestral temple on the right and the altars of soil and grain on the left.

sentences.zh: 置太祖之廟，並高祖已下二昭二穆，凡五。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor's temple was established, with two zhao and two mu from the High Ancestor downward—five in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor's temple was established, with two zhao and two mu from the High Ancestor downward—five in all.

sentences.zh: 親盡則遷。

translations.literal: When affection was exhausted they were moved.
translations.idiomatic: When affection was exhausted they were moved upward.

sentences.zh: 其有德者謂之祧，廟亦不毀。

translations.literal: Those with virtue were called tiao; their temples were also not destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Those with virtue were called tiao; their temples were also not destroyed.

sentences.zh: 閔帝受禪，追尊皇祖為德皇帝，文王為文皇帝，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: When Emperor Min received the abdication, the Grand Ancestor was posthumously honored as Emperor De, Emperor Wen as Emperor Wen, with the temple name Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Min received the abdication, the Grand Ancestor was posthumously honored as Emperor De, Emperor Wen as Emperor Wen, with the temple name Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 擬已上三廟遞遷，至太祖不毀。

translations.literal: It was planned that the three temples above would be moved in sequence, up to the Grand Ancestor who would not be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: It was planned that the three temples above would be moved in sequence, up to the Grand Ancestor who would not be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 其下相承置二昭二穆為五焉。

translations.literal: Below that, two zhao and two mu were established as five.
translations.idiomatic: Below that, two zhao and two mu were established as five in all.

sentences.zh: 明帝崩，廟號世宗，武帝崩，廟號高祖，並為祧廟而不毀。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, the temple name was Imperial Ancestor; when Emperor Wu died, the temple name was High Ancestor—both were tiao temples and not destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, the temple name was Imperial Ancestor; when Emperor Wu died, the temple name was High Ancestor—both were tiao temples and not destroyed.

sentences.zh: 其時祭，各於其廟，祫禘則于太祖廟，亦以皇后預祭。

translations.literal: Seasonal sacrifices were each at their own temple; xia and di were at the Grand Ancestor's temple; the empress also participated in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal sacrifices were each performed at their own temple; xia and di were performed at the Grand Ancestor's temple; the empress also participated in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其儀與後齊同。

translations.literal: The ceremony was the same as under Later Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed Later Qi practice.

sentences.zh: 所異者，皇后亞獻訖，後又薦加豆之籩，其實菱芡芹菹兔醢。

translations.literal: What differed was that after the empress's secondary presentation, she again presented added baskets of beans—their substance being water caltrop, gorgon fruit, pickled celery, and rabbit paste.
translations.idiomatic: What differed was that after the empress's secondary presentation, she again presented added baskets of beans—their substance being water caltrop, gorgon fruit, pickled celery, and rabbit paste.

sentences.zh: 塚宰終獻訖，皇后親撤豆，降還板位。

translations.literal: When the Grand Steward's final presentation was complete, the empress personally withdrew the beans and descended to the bench.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Steward's final presentation was complete, the empress personally withdrew the beans and descended to the bench.

sentences.zh: 然後太祝撤焉。

translations.literal: Then the Grand Invoker withdrew them.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Grand Invoker withdrew the offerings.

sentences.zh: 高祖既受命，遣兼太保宇文善、兼太尉李詢，奉策詣同州，告皇考桓王廟，兼用女巫，同家人之禮。

translations.literal: After the High Ancestor received the mandate, Acting Grand Mentor Yuwen Shan and Acting Grand Commandant Li Xun were dispatched with credentials to Tong Province to announce at the temple of the Imperial Father Prince Huan, also using a shamaness in the manner of a household rite.
translations.idiomatic: After the High Ancestor received the mandate, Acting Grand Mentor Yuwen Shan and Acting Grand Commandant Li Xun were dispatched with credentials to Tong Province to announce at the temple of the Imperial Father Prince Huan, also employing a shamaness in the manner of a household rite.

sentences.zh: 上皇考桓王尊號為武元皇帝，皇妣尊號為元明皇后，奉迎神主，歸於京師。

translations.literal: The Imperial Father Prince Huan was given the honorific title Emperor Wuyuan, the Imperial Mother the honorific title Empress Yuanming; the spirit tablets were escorted back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Father Prince Huan was given the honorific title Emperor Wuyuan, the Imperial Mother the honorific title Empress Yuanming; the spirit tablets were escorted back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 犧牲尚赤，祭用日出。

translations.literal: Victims favored red; sacrifice used sunrise.
translations.idiomatic: Victims favored red; sacrifice was performed at sunrise.

sentences.zh: 是時帝崇建社廟，改周制，左宗廟而右社稷。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor greatly built the altars of soil and grain, changing Zhou practice—ancestral temple on the left, altars of soil and grain on the right.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor greatly built the altars of soil and grain, changing Zhou practice—the ancestral temple on the left, altars of soil and grain on the right.

sentences.zh: 宗廟未言始祖，又無受命之祧，自高祖已下，置四親廟，同殿異室而已。

translations.literal: The ancestral temple did not yet name a Founding Ancestor, nor was there a tiao of receiving the mandate; from the High Ancestor downward, four intimate temples were established, sharing one hall but with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple did not yet name a Founding Ancestor, nor was there a tiao of receiving the mandate; from the High Ancestor downward, four intimate temples were established, sharing one hall but with separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 一曰皇高祖太原府君廟，二曰皇曾祖康王廟，三曰皇祖獻王廟，四曰皇考太祖武元皇帝廟。

translations.literal: First, the temple of the Great-Great-Grandfather Prince of Taiyuan; second, the temple of the Great-Grandfather Prince Kang; third, the temple of the Grandfather Prince Xian; fourth, the temple of the Imperial Father Grand Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: First, the temple of the Great-Great-Grandfather Prince of Taiyuan; second, the temple of the Great-Grandfather Prince Kang; third, the temple of the Grandfather Prince Xian; fourth, the temple of the Imperial Father Grand Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 擬祖遷於上，而太祖之廟不毀。

translations.literal: It was planned that when ancestors were moved upward, the Grand Ancestor's temple would not be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: It was planned that when ancestors were moved upward in the sequence, the Grand Ancestor's temple would not be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 各以孟月，饗乙太牢。

translations.literal: Each in the first month of the season, feasted with the secondary great offering.
translations.idiomatic: Each in the first month of the season, feasts were offered with the secondary great offering.

sentences.zh: 四時薦新於太廟，有司行事，而不出神主。

translations.literal: Seasonal new offerings at the Grand Temple were performed by officials without removing the spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal new offerings at the Grand Temple were performed by officials without removing the spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 祔祭之禮，並準時饗。

translations.literal: Enshrinement sacrifices all followed seasonal feasts.
translations.idiomatic: Enshrinement sacrifices all followed seasonal feast practice.

sentences.zh: 其司命，戶以春，灶以夏，門以秋，行以冬，各於享廟日，中霤則以季夏祀黃郊日，各命有司，祭於廟西門道南。

translations.literal: For the Director of Fate, the Hearth in spring, the Stove in summer, the Gate in autumn, the Road in winter—each on the day of feasting at the temple; the Central Drain on the day of the yellow suburban sacrifice in the last month of summer—each ordered to relevant officials to sacrifice south of the west gate of the temple.
translations.idiomatic: For the Director of Fate, the Hearth in spring, the Stove in summer, the Gate in autumn, the Road in winter—each on the day of feasting at the temple; the Central Drain on the day of the yellow suburban sacrifice in the last month of summer—each ordered to relevant officials to sacrifice south of the west gate of the temple.

sentences.zh: 牲以少牢。

translations.literal: Victims were the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: Victims were the secondary offering.

sentences.zh: 三年一祫，以孟冬，遷主、未遷主合食于太祖之廟。

translations.literal: Every three years a xia, in the first month of winter—moved and unmoved spirit tablets combined in feast at the Grand Ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years a xia, in the first month of winter—moved and unmoved spirit tablets combined in feast at the Grand Ancestor's temple.

sentences.zh: 五年一禘，以孟夏，其遷主各食於所遷之廟，未遷之主各於其廟。

translations.literal: Every five years a di, in the first month of summer—moved spirit tablets each feasted at their moved temple, unmoved spirit tablets each at their own temple.
translations.idiomatic: Every five years a di, in the first month of summer—moved spirit tablets each feasted at their moved temple, unmoved spirit tablets each at their own temple.

sentences.zh: 禘祫之月，則停時饗，而陳諸瑞物及伐國所獲珍奇於廟庭，及以功臣配饗。

translations.literal: In the months of di and xia, seasonal feasts were suspended; auspicious objects and rare treasures captured from conquered states were displayed in the temple court, and meritorious ministers were associated in the feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the months of di and xia, seasonal feasts were suspended; auspicious objects and rare treasures captured from conquered states were displayed in the temple court, and meritorious ministers were associated in the feast.

sentences.zh: 並以其日，使祀先代王公：帝堯於平陽，以契配；

translations.literal: On those same days, envoys sacrificed to ancient dynastic kings: Emperor Yao at Pingyang, with Qi associated;
translations.idiomatic: On those same days, envoys sacrificed to ancient dynastic kings: Emperor Yao at Pingyang, with Qi associated;

sentences.zh: 帝舜於河東，咎繇配；

translations.literal: Emperor Shun at Hedong, with Gao Yao associated;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shun at Hedong, with Gao Yao associated;

sentences.zh: 夏禹于安邑，伯益配；

translations.literal: Yu of Xia at Anyi, with Bo Yi associated;
translations.idiomatic: Yu of Xia at Anyi, with Bo Yi associated;

sentences.zh: 殷湯于汾陰，伊尹配；

translations.literal: Tang of Yin at Fenyin, with Yi Yin associated;
translations.idiomatic: Tang of Yin at Fenyin, with Yi Yin associated;

sentences.zh: 文王、武王於斁渭之郊，周公、召公配；

translations.literal: King Wen and King Wu at the Wei and Qi suburbs, with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao associated;
translations.idiomatic: King Wen and King Wu at the Wei and Qi suburbs, with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao associated;

sentences.zh: 漢高帝於長陵，蕭何配。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Han at Changling, with Xiao He associated.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu of Han at Changling, with Xiao He associated.

sentences.zh: 各以一太牢而無樂。

translations.literal: Each used one great offering without music.
translations.idiomatic: Each used one great offering without music.

sentences.zh: 配者饗於廟庭。

translations.literal: Associated figures feasted in the temple court.
translations.idiomatic: Associated figures received feast offerings in the temple court.

sentences.zh: 大業元年，煬帝欲遵周法，營立七廟，詔有司詳定其禮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daye, Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou practice and establish seven temples; an edict ordered officials to determine the rite in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daye, Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou practice and establish seven temples; an edict ordered officials to determine the rite in detail.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎、攝太常少卿許善心與博士褚亮等議曰：

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites and Acting Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies Xu Shanshan, together with Erudite Chu Liang and others, submitted an opinion:
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites and Acting Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies Xu Shanshan, together with Erudite Chu Liang and others, submitted an opinion:

sentences.zh: 謹案《禮記》：「天子七廟，三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。

translations.literal: Respectfully according to the Record of Rites: 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple making seven.'
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully according to the Record of Rites: 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple making seven.'

sentences.zh: 」鄭玄注曰：「此周制也。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan's commentary says: 'This is Zhou practice.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan's commentary says: 'This is Zhou practice.'

sentences.zh: 七者，太祖及文王、武王之祧，與親廟四也。

translations.literal: Seven means the Grand Ancestor and the tiao of King Wen and King Wu, together with the four intimate temples.
translations.idiomatic: Seven means the Grand Ancestor and the tiao of King Wen and King Wu, together with the four intimate temples.

sentences.zh: 殷則六廟，契及湯與二昭二穆也。

translations.literal: Yin had six temples—Qi and Tang together with two zhao and two mu.
translations.idiomatic: Yin had six temples—Qi and Tang together with two zhao and two mu.

sentences.zh: 夏則五廟，無太祖，禹與二昭二穆而已。

translations.literal: Xia had five temples—no Grand Ancestor; Yu together with two zhao and two mu only.
translations.idiomatic: Xia had five temples—no Grand Ancestor; Yu together with two zhao and two mu only.

sentences.zh: 」玄又據王者禘其祖之所自出，而立四廟。

translations.literal: Xuan also held that the king performs di to the ancestor from whom he derives, and establishes four temples.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan also held that the king performs di to the ancestor from whom he derives, and establishes four temples.

sentences.zh: 案鄭玄義，天子唯立四親廟，並始祖而為五。

translations.literal: According to Zheng Xuan's meaning, the Son of Heaven establishes only four intimate temples, with the Founding Ancestor making five.
translations.idiomatic: According to Zheng Xuan's meaning, the Son of Heaven establishes only four intimate temples, with the Founding Ancestor making five.

sentences.zh: 周以文、武為受命之祖，特立二祧，是為七廟。

translations.literal: Zhou took Wen and Wu as ancestors of receiving the mandate and specially established two tiao—making seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou took Wen and Wu as ancestors of receiving the mandate and specially established two tiao—making seven temples.

sentences.zh: 王肅注《禮記》：「尊者尊統上，卑者尊統下。

translations.literal: Wang Su's commentary on the Record of Rites: 'The honored honor the line above; the humble honor the line below.'
translations.idiomatic: Wang Su's commentary on the Record of Rites: 'The honored honor the line above; the humble honor the line below.'

sentences.zh: 故天子七廟，諸侯五廟。

translations.literal: Therefore the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples.

sentences.zh: 其有殊功異德，非太祖而不毀，不在七廟之數。

translations.literal: Those with special merit and virtue, though not the Grand Ancestor, are not destroyed—not counted within the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: Those with special merit and virtue, though not the Grand Ancestor, are not destroyed—not counted within the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 」案王肅以為天子七廟，是通百代之言，又據《王制》之文「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟」，降二為差。

translations.literal: According to Wang Su, the Son of Heaven's seven temples is a statement applying to a hundred generations; also according to the Royal Regulations: 'Son of Heaven seven temples, feudal lords five temples, grand masters three temples'—reduced by two at each rank.
translations.idiomatic: According to Wang Su, the Son of Heaven's seven temples is a statement applying to a hundred generations; also according to the Royal Regulations: 'Son of Heaven seven temples, feudal lords five temples, grand masters three temples'—reduced by two at each rank.

sentences.zh: 是則天子立四親廟，又立高祖之父，高祖之祖，並太祖而為七。

translations.literal: Thus the Son of Heaven establishes four intimate temples, also establishing the High Ancestor's father and the High Ancestor's grandfather, with the Grand Ancestor making seven.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Son of Heaven establishes four intimate temples, also establishing the High Ancestor's father and the High Ancestor's grandfather, with the Grand Ancestor making seven.

sentences.zh: 周有文、武、薑嫄，合為十廟。

translations.literal: Zhou had Wen, Wu, and Jiang Yuan—together ten temples.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou had Wen, Wu, and Jiang Yuan—together ten temples.

sentences.zh: 漢諸帝之廟各立，無迭毀之義。

translations.literal: Han emperors' temples were each separately established, with no practice of sequential destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Han emperors' temples were each separately established, with no practice of sequential destruction.

sentences.zh: 至元帝時，貢禹、匡衡之徒，始建其禮，以高帝為太祖，而立四親廟，是為五廟。

translations.literal: At the time of Emperor Yuan, Gong Yu, Kuang Heng, and others first established this rite, with Emperor Gaozu as Grand Ancestor and four intimate temples established—making five temples.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of Emperor Yuan, Gong Yu, Kuang Heng, and others first established this rite, with Emperor Gaozu as Grand Ancestor and four intimate temples established—making five temples.

sentences.zh: 唯劉歆以為天子七廟，諸侯五廟，降殺以兩之義。

translations.literal: Only Liu Xin held that the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples—the meaning of reduction by two.
translations.idiomatic: Only Liu Xin held that the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples—the meaning of reduction by two.

sentences.zh: 七者，其正法，可常數也，宗不在數內，有功德則宗之，不可預設為數也。

translations.literal: Seven is the correct constant number; tiao are not counted within the number—those with merit are honored as tiao and cannot be preset as a number.
translations.idiomatic: Seven is the correct constant number; tiao are not counted within the number—those with merit are honored as tiao and cannot be preset as a number.

sentences.zh: 是以班固稱，考論諸儒之議，劉歆博而篤矣。

translations.literal: Therefore Ban Gu praised, examining the opinions of the various scholars, that Liu Xin was comprehensive and solid.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Ban Gu praised, examining the opinions of the various scholars, that Liu Xin was comprehensive and solid.

sentences.zh: 光武即位，建高廟於洛陽，乃立南頓君以上四廟，就祖宗而為七。

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangwu ascended the throne, he built the High Temple at Luoyang and established four temples from Lord Nandun upward, with the ancestors making seven.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangwu ascended the throne, he built the High Temple at Luoyang and established four temples from Lord Nandun upward, with the ancestors making seven.

sentences.zh: 至魏初，高堂隆為鄭學，議立親廟四，太祖武帝，猶在四親之內，乃虛置太祖及二祧，以待後代。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wei, Gao Tanglong followed Zheng's learning and proposed establishing four intimate temples, with Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu still within the four intimates—thus leaving the Grand Ancestor and two tiao vacant, awaiting later generations.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wei, Gao Tanglong followed Zheng's learning and proposed establishing four intimate temples, with Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu still within the four intimates—thus leaving the Grand Ancestor and two tiao vacant, awaiting later generations.

sentences.zh: 至景初間，乃依王肅，更立五世、六世祖，就四親而為六廟。

translations.literal: By the Jingchu period, Wang Su was followed and five-generation and six-generation ancestors were established, with the four intimates making six temples.
translations.idiomatic: By the Jingchu period, Wang Su was followed and five-generation and six-generation ancestors were established, with the four intimates making six temples.

sentences.zh: 晉武受禪，博議宗祀，自文帝以上六世祖征西府君，而宣帝亦序于昭穆，未升太祖，故祭止六也。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Jin received the abdication, ancestral sacrifice was broadly debated; from Emperor Wen upward the six-generation ancestor was the Western Expedition Director, and Emperor Xuan was also ordered in zhao-mu sequence without ascending to Grand Ancestor—therefore sacrifice stopped at six.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Jin received the abdication, ancestral sacrifice was broadly debated; from Emperor Wen upward the six-generation ancestor was the Western Expedition Director, and Emperor Xuan was also ordered in zhao-mu sequence without ascending to Grand Ancestor—therefore sacrifice stopped at six.

sentences.zh: 江左中興，賀循知禮，至於寢廟之儀，皆依魏、晉舊事。

translations.literal: In the Jiang-zuo restoration, He Xun understood ritual; as for sleeping-chamber temple practice, all followed Wei and Jin old affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiang-zuo restoration, He Xun understood ritual; as for sleeping-chamber temple practice, all followed Wei and Jin old affairs.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝初受晉命為王，依諸侯立親廟四。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Song first received the Jin mandate as king, he established four intimate temples according to feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Song first received the Jin mandate as king, he established four intimate temples according to feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 即位之後，增祠五世祖相國掾府君、六世祖右北平府君，止於六廟。

translations.literal: After ascending the throne, he added sacrifice to the five-generation ancestor Chancellor and six-generation ancestor Right Beiping Director—stopping at six temples.
translations.idiomatic: After ascending the throne, he added sacrifice to the five-generation ancestor Chancellor and six-generation ancestor Right Beiping Director—stopping at six temples.

sentences.zh: 逮身歿，主升從昭穆，猶太祖之位也。

translations.literal: At his death the spirit tablet ascended in zhao-mu sequence, still at the Grand Ancestor's position.
translations.idiomatic: At his death the spirit tablet ascended in zhao-mu sequence, still at the Grand Ancestor's position.

sentences.zh: 降及齊、梁，守而弗革，加崇迭毀，禮無違舊。

translations.literal: Down to Qi and Liang, they maintained without change, adding honors and sequential destruction—ritual without violating the old.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Qi and Liang, they maintained without change, adding honors and sequential destruction—ritual without violating the old.

sentences.zh: 臣等又案姬周自太祖已下，皆別立廟，至於禘祫，俱合食于太祖。

translations.literal: We also examine that from the Grand Ancestor downward under Ji Zhou, separate temples were each established; in di and xia all combined in feast at the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: We also examine that from the Grand Ancestor downward under Ji Zhou, separate temples were each established; in di and xia all combined in feast at the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 是以炎漢之初，諸廟各立，歲時嘗享，亦隨處而祭，所用廟樂，皆象功德而歌儛焉。

translations.literal: Thus at the beginning of Han, temples were each separately established; seasonal chang and xiang were also sacrificed at each location; the temple music used all imitated merit and was sung and danced.
translations.idiomatic: Thus at the beginning of Han, temples were each separately established; seasonal chang and xiang were also sacrificed at each location; the temple music used all imitated merit and was sung and danced.

sentences.zh: 至光武乃總立一堂，而群主異室，斯則新承寇亂，欲從約省。

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangwu unified in one hall with lords in separate chambers, this was because he newly inherited disorder and wished to follow simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangwu unified in one hall with lords in separate chambers, this was because he newly inherited disorder and wished to follow simplicity.

sentences.zh: 自此以來，因循不變。

translations.literal: From this time onward it was handed down unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward it was handed down unchanged.

sentences.zh: 伏惟高祖文皇帝，睿哲玄覽，神武應期，受命開基，垂統聖嗣，當文明之運，定祖宗之禮。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that the High Ancestor Emperor Wen, with profound wisdom and mysterious insight, divine martial response to the season, received the mandate and opened the foundation, bequeathing the enterprise to the sage successor.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully consider that the High Ancestor Emperor Wen, with profound wisdom and mysterious insight, divine martial response to the season, received the mandate and opened the foundation, bequeathing the enterprise to the sage successor.

sentences.zh: 且損益不同，沿襲異趣，時王所制，可以垂法。

translations.literal: In the age of civilization he fixed ancestral ritual; additions and subtractions differ, handed-down practices differ in tendency—the ruler of the age establishes what can be handed down as law.
translations.idiomatic: In the age of civilization he fixed ancestral ritual; additions and subtractions differ, handed-down practices differ in tendency—the ruler of the age establishes what can be handed down as law.

sentences.zh: 自歷代以來，雜用王、鄭二義，若尋其指歸，校以優劣，康成止論周代，非謂經通，子雍總貫皇王，事兼長遠。

translations.literal: From successive generations, Wang and Zheng's two meanings were mixed; if one seeks their intent and compares their superiority, Zheng Cheng only discussed the Zhou age—not meaning to apply to the classics universally; Ziyong comprehensively covered emperors and kings, with affairs extending far.
translations.idiomatic: From successive generations, Wang and Zheng's two meanings were mixed; if one seeks their intent and compares their superiority, Zheng Cheng only discussed the Zhou age—not meaning to apply to the classics universally; Ziyong comprehensively covered emperors and kings, with affairs extending far.

sentences.zh: 今請依據古典，崇建七廟。

translations.literal: We now request following the ancient canon and greatly establishing seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: We now request following the ancient canon and greatly establishing seven temples.

sentences.zh: 受命之祖，宜別立廟祧，百代之後，為不毀之法。

translations.literal: The ancestor of receiving the mandate should have a separate tiao temple; after a hundred generations this would be the law of non-destruction.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestor of receiving the mandate should have a separate tiao temple; after a hundred generations this would be the law of non-destruction.

sentences.zh: 至於鑾駕親奉，申孝享于高廟，有司行事，竭誠敬於群主，俾夫規模可則，嚴祀易遵，表有功而彰明德，大復古而貴能變。

translations.literal: As for the imperial carriage personally performing, extending filial feasting at the High Temple; officials performing, exhausting reverence at the lords—then the model can be followed, solemn sacrifice easily observed, showing merit and displaying bright virtue, greatly restoring antiquity while honoring the ability to change.
translations.idiomatic: As for the imperial carriage personally performing, extending filial feasting at the High Temple; officials performing, exhausting reverence at the lords—then the model can be followed, solemn sacrifice easily observed, showing merit and displaying bright virtue, greatly restoring antiquity while honoring the ability to change.

sentences.zh: 臣又案周人立廟，亦無處置之文。

translations.literal: We also examine that in establishing temples Zhou people also had no text on placement.
translations.idiomatic: We also examine that in establishing temples the Zhou people also had no text on placement.

sentences.zh: 據塚人處職而言之，先王居中，以昭穆為左右。

translations.literal: According to the Tomb Master in performing duties, the former king was at the center, with zhao and mu as left and right.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tomb Master in performing duties, the former king was at the center, with zhao and mu as left and right.

sentences.zh: 阮忱撰《禮圖》，亦從此義。

translations.literal: Ruan Chen's Sacrificial Diagram also follows this meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Chen's Sacrificial Diagram also follows this meaning.

sentences.zh: 漢京諸廟既遠，又不序禘祫。

translations.literal: Han capital temples were already distant, and di and xia were not ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Han capital temples were already distant, and di and xia were not ordered.

sentences.zh: 今若依周制，理有未安，雜用漢儀，事難全采。

translations.literal: If one now follows Zhou practice, principle is not yet settled; mixing Han practice, affairs are hard to fully adopt.
translations.idiomatic: If one now follows Zhou practice, principle is not yet settled; mixing Han practice, affairs are hard to fully adopt.

sentences.zh: 謹詳立別圖，附之議末。

translations.literal: We respectfully submit a separate diagram, attached at the end of the opinion.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully submit a separate diagram, attached at the end of the opinion.

sentences.zh: 其圖，太祖、高祖各一殿，准周文武二祧，與始祖而三。

translations.literal: The diagram: the Grand Ancestor and High Ancestor each one hall, following Zhou's two tiao of Wen and Wu, with the Founding Ancestor making three.
translations.idiomatic: The diagram: the Grand Ancestor and High Ancestor each one hall, following Zhou's two tiao of Wen and Wu, with the Founding Ancestor making three.

sentences.zh: 餘並分室而祭。

translations.literal: The remainder all sacrifice in separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder all sacrifice in separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 始祖及二祧之外，從迭毀之法。

translations.literal: Apart from the Founding Ancestor and two tiao, the sequential destruction law was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the Founding Ancestor and two tiao, the sequential destruction law was followed.

sentences.zh: 詔可，未及創制。

translations.literal: An edict approved this; construction had not yet been undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this; construction had not yet been undertaken.

sentences.zh: 既營建洛邑，帝無心京師，乃於東都固本裏北，起天經宮，以游高祖衣冠，四時致祭。

translations.literal: After Luoyang was built, the emperor had no heart for the capital; at Benli north of the eastern capital the Tianjing Palace was built to tour the High Ancestor's robes and cap, with seasonal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: After Luoyang was built, the emperor had no heart for the capital; at Benli north of the eastern capital the Tianjing Palace was built to display the High Ancestor's robes and cap, with seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 於三年，有司奏，請准前議，于東京建立宗廟。

translations.literal: In the third year, officials memorialized requesting following the previous opinion to establish the ancestral temple at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, officials memorialized requesting following the previous opinion to establish the ancestral temple at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 帝謂秘書監柳抃曰：「今始祖及二祧已具，今後子孫，處朕何所？

translations.literal: The emperor said to Secretary Supervisor Liu Bian: 'Now the Founding Ancestor and two tiao are already complete—where shall later generations place me?'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Secretary Supervisor Liu Bian: 'Now the Founding Ancestor and two tiao are already complete—where shall later generations place me?'

sentences.zh: 」又下詔，唯議別立高祖之廟，屬有行役，遂複停寢。

translations.literal: Another edict discussed only establishing the High Ancestor's temple separately; because of ongoing labor, it was again suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict discussed only establishing the High Ancestor's temple separately; because of ongoing labor, it was again suspended.

sentences.zh: 自古帝王之興，皆稟五精之氣。

translations.literal: Since antiquity, the rise of emperors and kings all received the qi of the Five Essences.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, the rise of emperors and kings all received the qi of the Five Essences.

sentences.zh: 每易姓而起，以致太平，必封乎太山，所以告成功也。

translations.literal: Each time a surname changed and order was restored to attain great peace, feng was necessarily performed on Mount Tai to announce success.
translations.idiomatic: Each time a dynasty changed and order was restored to attain great peace, feng was necessarily performed on Mount Tai to announce success.

sentences.zh: 封訖而禪乎梁甫。

translations.literal: After feng was complete, shan was performed at Liangfu.
translations.idiomatic: After feng was complete, shan was performed at Liangfu.

sentences.zh: 梁甫者，太山之支山卑下者也，能以其道配成高德。

translations.literal: Liangfu is a branch mountain of Mount Tai, low and humble, able with its Way to match and complete high virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Liangfu is a branch mountain of Mount Tai, low and humble, able with its Way to match and complete high virtue.

sentences.zh: 故禪乎梁甫，亦以告太平也。

translations.literal: Therefore shan at Liangfu also announces great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore shan at Liangfu also announces the achievement of great peace.

sentences.zh: 封禪者，高厚之謂也。

translations.literal: Feng and shan mean honoring height and thickness.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and shan mean honoring height and thickness.

sentences.zh: 天以高為尊，地以厚為德，增太山之高，以報天也，厚梁甫之基，以報地也。

translations.literal: Heaven is honored by height, earth by thickness; Mount Tai's height is increased to repay Heaven, Liangfu's foundation thickened to repay earth.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is honored by height, earth by thickness; Mount Tai's height is increased to repay Heaven, Liangfu's foundation thickened to repay earth.

sentences.zh: 明天之所命，功成事就，有益於天地，若天地之更高厚雲。

translations.literal: Making clear Heaven's mandate—when achievement is complete and affairs finished, benefiting Heaven and earth, as if Heaven and earth were higher and thicker.
translations.idiomatic: Making clear Heaven's mandate—when achievement is complete and affairs finished, benefiting Heaven and earth, as if Heaven and earth were higher and thicker.

sentences.zh: 《記》曰：「王者因天事天，因地事地。

translations.literal: The Record says: 'The king because of Heaven serves Heaven, because of earth serves earth.'
translations.idiomatic: The Record says: 'The king because of Heaven serves Heaven, because of earth serves earth.'

sentences.zh: 因名山升中於天，而鳳凰降，龜龍格。

translations.literal: Because of famous mountains ascending to the center of Heaven, then the phoenix descends and the turtle-dragon arrives.
translations.idiomatic: Because of famous mountains ascending to the center of Heaven, then the phoenix descends and the turtle-dragon arrives.

sentences.zh: 」齊桓公既霸而欲封禪，管仲言之詳矣。

translations.literal: Duke Huan of Qi, having achieved hegemony, wished to perform feng and shan—Guan Zhong spoke of it in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi, having achieved hegemony, wished to perform feng and shan—Guan Zhong spoke of it in detail.

sentences.zh: 秦始皇既黜儒生，而封太山，禪梁甫，其封事皆秘之，不可得而傳也。

translations.literal: Emperor Qin Shihuang, having dismissed the literati, performed feng on Mount Tai and shan at Liangfu; the feng affairs were all kept secret and cannot be transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Qin Shihuang, having dismissed the literati, performed feng on Mount Tai and shan at Liangfu; the feng affairs were all kept secret and cannot be transmitted.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝頗采方士之言，造為玉牒，而編以金繩，封廣九尺，高一丈二尺。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han largely adopted the words of the alchemical masters, making jade registers bound with golden cord, the feng tablet nine chi wide and one zhang two chi high.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han largely adopted the words of the alchemical masters, making jade registers bound with golden cord, the feng tablet nine chi wide and one zhang two chi high.

sentences.zh: 光武中興，聿遵其故。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu in the restoration followed the old practice.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu in the restoration followed the old practice.

sentences.zh: 晉、宋、齊、梁及陳，皆未遑其議。

translations.literal: Jin, Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen all had no leisure for this discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Jin, Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen all had no leisure for this discussion.

sentences.zh: 後齊有巡狩之禮，並登封之儀，竟不之行也。

translations.literal: Later Qi had the touring sacrifice and also the ascending feng ceremony, but ultimately did not perform it.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi had the touring sacrifice and also the ascending feng ceremony, but ultimately did not perform it.

sentences.zh: 開皇十四年，群臣請封禪。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kaihuang, officials requested feng and shan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Kaihuang, officials requested feng and shan.

sentences.zh: 高祖不納。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor did not accept.

sentences.zh: 晉王廣又率百官抗表固請，帝命有司草儀注。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Guang again led all officials in a memorial firmly requesting; the emperor ordered officials to draft the ritual text.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Guang again led all officials in a memorial firmly requesting; the emperor ordered officials to draft the ritual text.

sentences.zh: 於是牛弘、辛彥之、許善心、姚察、虞世基等創定其禮，奏之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Niu Hong, Xin Yanzhi, Xu Shanshan, Yao Cha, Yu Shiji, and others created and fixed the rite and memorialized it.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Niu Hong, Xin Yanzhi, Xu Shanshan, Yao Cha, Yu Shiji, and others created and fixed the rite and memorialized it.

sentences.zh: 帝逡巡其事，曰：「此事體大，朕何德以堪之。

translations.literal: The emperor hesitated over the affair and said: 'This matter is of great substance—what virtue have I to bear it?'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hesitated over the affair and said: 'This matter is of great substance—what virtue have I to bear it?'

sentences.zh: 但當東狩，因拜岱山耳。

translations.literal: But when touring the east, I shall worship Mount Dai—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: But when touring the east, I shall worship Mount Dai—that is all.

sentences.zh: 」十五年春，行幸兗州，遂次岱嶽。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year he traveled to Yan Province and then stopped at Mount Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year he traveled to Yan Province and then stopped at Mount Dai.

sentences.zh: 為壇，如南郊，又壝外為柴壇，飾神廟，展宮縣於庭。

translations.literal: An altar was made as at the southern suburb; outside the enclosure a firewood altar was made, spirit temples decorated, palace bells displayed in the court.
translations.idiomatic: An altar was made as at the southern suburb; outside the enclosure a firewood altar was made, spirit temples decorated, palace bells displayed in the court.

sentences.zh: 為埋坎二，于南門外。

translations.literal: Two burial pits were made outside the south gate.
translations.idiomatic: Two burial pits were made outside the south gate.

sentences.zh: 又陳樂設位於青帝壇，如南郊。

translations.literal: Music and seating were also arranged at the Green Emperor's altar, as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Music and seating were also arranged at the Green Emperor's altar, as at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 帝服袞冕，乘金輅，備法駕而行。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe, rode the gold chariot, and proceeded with full imperial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the dragon-and-phoenix crown robe, rode the gold chariot, and proceeded with full imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，遂詣青帝壇而祭焉。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he then proceeded to the Green Emperor's altar and sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, he then proceeded to the Green Emperor's altar and sacrificed.

sentences.zh: 開皇十四年閏十月，詔東鎮沂山，南鎮會稽山，北鎮醫無閭山，冀州鎮霍山，並就山立祠；

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month of the fourteenth year of Kaihuang, an edict: the Eastern Guardian at Mount Yi, Southern Guardian at Mount Kuaiji, Northern Guardian at Mount Yiwulu, Huo Mountain as Guardian of Ji Province—all had shrines established on the mountains;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month of the fourteenth year of Kaihuang, an edict: the Eastern Guardian at Mount Yi, Southern Guardian at Mount Kuaiji, Northern Guardian at Mount Yiwulu, Huo Mountain as Guardian of Ji Province—all had shrines established on the mountains;

sentences.zh: 東海於會稽縣界，南海于南海鎮南，並近海立祠。

translations.literal: the Eastern Sea at the border of Kuaiji County, the Southern Sea at the south of Nanhai Guardian—all had shrines established near the sea.
translations.idiomatic: the Eastern Sea at the border of Kuaiji County, the Southern Sea at the south of Nanhai Guardian—all had shrines established near the sea.

sentences.zh: 及四瀆、吳山，並取側近巫一人，主知灑掃，並命多蒔松柏。

translations.literal: And the Four Rivers, Mount Wu—all took a nearby shaman, one person each, to oversee sweeping, and ordered many pines and cypresses planted.
translations.idiomatic: And the Four Rivers, Mount Wu—all took a nearby shaman, one person each, to oversee sweeping, and ordered many pines and cypresses planted.

sentences.zh: 其霍山，雩祀日遣使就焉。

translations.literal: For Huo Mountain, on rain sacrifice days an envoy was sent there.
translations.idiomatic: For Huo Mountain, on rain sacrifice days an envoy was sent there.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，又詔北鎮于營州龍山立祠。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year, another edict: the Northern Guardian at Dragon Mountain in Ying Province had a shrine established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year, another edict: the Northern Guardian at Dragon Mountain in Ying Province had a shrine established.

sentences.zh: 東鎮晉州霍山鎮，若修造，並准西鎮吳山造神廟。

translations.literal: The Eastern Guardian at Huo Mountain in Jin Province—if repaired, all followed the Western Guardian Mount Wu in building spirit temples.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Guardian at Huo Mountain in Jin Province—if repaired, all followed the Western Guardian Mount Wu in building spirit temples.

sentences.zh: 大業中，氇昜帝因幸晉陽，遂祭恆嶽。

translations.literal: In the Daye period, Emperor Yang, because he visited Jinyang, then sacrificed at Mount Heng.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daye period, Emperor Yang, because he visited Jinyang, then sacrificed at Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 其禮頗采高祖拜岱宗儀，增置二壇，命道士女官數十人，於鹆遺中設醮。

translations.literal: The rite largely adopted the High Ancestor's worship of Mount Dai, with two altars added; several tens of Daoist priests and female officials set up jiao rites in the Yiwu valley.
translations.idiomatic: The rite largely adopted the High Ancestor's worship of Mount Dai, with two altars added; several tens of Daoist priests and female officials set up jiao rites in the Yiwu valley.

sentences.zh: 十年，幸東都，過祀華嶽，築場於廟側。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, visiting the eastern capital, he passed to sacrifice at Mount Hua, building a platform beside the temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, visiting the eastern capital, he passed to sacrifice at Mount Hua, building a platform beside the temple.

sentences.zh: 事乃不經，蓋非有司之定禮也。

translations.literal: The affair was uncanonical—this was not the fixed rite of the relevant officials.
translations.idiomatic: The affair was uncanonical—this was not the fixed rite of the relevant officials.

sentences.zh: 《禮》：天子以春分朝日于東郊，秋分夕月於西郊。

translations.literal: The Rites: the Son of Heaven at the spring equinox greets the sun at the eastern suburb, at the autumn equinox greets the moon at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites prescribe that the Son of Heaven at the spring equinox greets the sun at the eastern suburb, at the autumn equinox greets the moon at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 漢法，不俟二分於東西郊，常以郊泰畤。

translations.literal: Han practice did not wait for the two equinoxes at the eastern and western suburbs, but always used the suburban Great Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Han practice did not wait for the two equinoxes at the eastern and western suburbs, but always used the suburban Great Altar.

sentences.zh: 旦出竹宮東向揖日，其夕西向揖月。

translations.literal: At dawn bowing east toward the sun from the bamboo palace; in the evening bowing west toward the moon.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn bowing east toward the sun from the bamboo palace; in the evening bowing west toward the moon.

sentences.zh: 魏文譏其煩褻，似家人之事，而以正月朝日於東門之外。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Wei criticized this as troublesome and irreverent, like a household affair; therefore in the first month he greeted the sun outside the eastern gate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Wei criticized this as troublesome and irreverent, like a household affair; therefore in the first month he greeted the sun outside the eastern gate.

sentences.zh: 前史又以為非時。

translations.literal: Previous histories also held this to be untimely.
translations.idiomatic: Previous histories also held this to be untimely.

sentences.zh: 及明帝太和元年二月丁亥，朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming of Wei in the first year of Taihe, on dinghai day of the second month, greeted the sun at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming of Wei in the first year of Taihe, on dinghai day of the second month, greeted the sun at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，夕月於西郊。

translations.literal: On jichou day of the eighth month, greeted the moon at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the eighth month, greeted the moon at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 始合于古。

translations.literal: This first accorded with antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: This first accorded with antiquity.

sentences.zh: 後周以春分朝日于國東門外，為壇，如其郊。

translations.literal: Later Zhou at the spring equinox greeted the sun outside the eastern gate of the capital, making an altar as at the suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou at the spring equinox greeted the sun outside the eastern gate of the capital, making an altar as at the suburb.

sentences.zh: 用特牲青幣，青圭有邸。

translations.literal: Used a single victim and green silks, green jade tablet with base.
translations.idiomatic: Used a single victim and green silks, green jade tablet with base.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘青輅，及祀官俱青冕，執事者青弁。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the green chariot; sacrificial officials all wore green crowns; active officials wore green caps.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode the green chariot; sacrificial officials all wore green crowns; active officials wore green caps.

sentences.zh: 司徒亞獻，宗伯終獻。

translations.literal: The Grand Steward made the secondary presentation, the Grand Herald the final presentation.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Steward made the secondary presentation, the Grand Herald the final presentation.

sentences.zh: 燔燎如圓丘。

translations.literal: Fire offering as at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Fire offering followed Round Mound practice.

sentences.zh: 秋分夕月于國西門外，為壇於坎中，方四丈，深四尺，燔燎禮如朝日。

translations.literal: At the autumn equinox the moon was greeted outside the western gate of the capital; an altar was made in a pit, four zhang square and four chi deep; fire offering rite as at greeting the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At the autumn equinox the moon was greeted outside the western gate of the capital; an altar was made in a pit, four zhang square and four chi deep; fire offering rite as at greeting the sun.

sentences.zh: 開皇初，于國東春明門外為壇，如其郊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang, outside the Chunming Gate east of the capital an altar was made as at the suburb.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaihuang, outside the Chunming Gate east of the capital an altar was made as at the suburb.

sentences.zh: 每以春分朝日。

translations.literal: Each spring equinox greeted the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Each spring equinox the sun was greeted.

sentences.zh: 又于國西開遠門外為坎，深三尺，廣四丈。

translations.literal: Also outside the Kaiyuan Gate west of the capital a pit was made, three chi deep and four zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: Also outside the Kaiyuan Gate west of the capital a pit was made, three chi deep and four zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 為壇于坎中，高一尺，廣四尺。
